sa: चोदयाश्वान् हृषीकेश संशप्तकगणान् प्रति। नैतै हास्यन्ति संग्रामं जीवन्त इति मे मतिः॥
en: 'O Hrishikesha urge my steeds against this host of the Samshaptakas. I think they will not give up the battle so long life will be extant in them.

sa: अभिमानेन भूतानामिमां गतिमुपागतम्। अहं वै विपुले तात कुले धनसमन्विते॥ अन्यस्मिजन्मनि विभो ज्ञानविज्ञानपारगः। अभवं तत्र जानानो ह्येतान् दोषान् मदात् सदा॥ संरब्ध एव भूतानां पृष्ठमांसमभक्षयम्। सोऽहं तेन च वृत्तेन भोजनेन च तेन वै॥ इमामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तः पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्। आदीप्तमिव चैलान्तं भ्रमरिव चार्दितम्॥ धावमानं सुसंरब्धं पश्य मां रजसान्वितम्। स्वाध्यायैस्तु महात्पापं हरन्ति गृहमेधिनः॥ दानैः पृथग्विधैश्चापि यथा प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। तथा पापकृतं विप्रमाश्रमस्थं महीपते॥ सर्वसङ्गविनिर्मुक्तं छन्दांस्य
en: It is through pride that living creatures come by such a miserable end. As for myself, I was born in a large family in a former birth of mine, O lord, and I was a perfect master of all branches of knowledge and al the sciences. I knew the immensity of all these faults, but moved by pride, I became blinded and ate the i meat attached to the vertebral columns of animals. On account of such conduct and such food, I have come by this state. Mark, the। reverses engendered by Time! Like a person whose cloth has caught fire at one end, or who is pursued by bees, see, I am running, filled with fear, and smeared with dust! The householders are rescued from all sins by a study of the wise. O Kshatriya, a sinful Brahmana becomes rescued from all his sins by a study of the Vedas, if he becomes a fores

sa: श्रुत्वा तु कुन्ती तद्वाक्यमर्थकामेन भाषितम्। सा निःश्वसन्ती दुःखार्ता मनसा विममर्श ह॥
en: Kunti too, hearing these words of his, which were spoken with the desire of benefit, began to sigh, being struck with sorrow and became depressed in mind also.

sa: यस्य सूर्यसमाः पञ्च सपत्नाः स्युः प्रहारिणः। कथमभ्युदये तेषां न प्रमुह्येत पण्डितः॥
en: Why should not a wise man be bewildered who has five adversaries effulgent as the sun, who are experts in smiting and have just come out from adversity?

sa: आज्येन तर्पयित्वाग्निं विधिवत्संस्कृतेन च। मन्त्रसिद्धं चक्रं कृत्वा पुरोधाः स ययौ तदा॥
en: Pleasing the (sacrificial) fire with (libations of) sanctified butter according to the ordinance, the priest (Dhaumya) cooked Charu with the aid of Mantras and performed the necessary rites.

sa: अस्मिन् राजकुले जातो जित्वा कृत्स्नां वसुंधराम्। धर्मार्थावखिलौ हित्वा वनं मौढ्यात् प्रतिष्ठसे॥
en: You are born in a royal family. Having conquered the whole Earth, do you foolishly wish to live in the forest after for-saking everything of virtue of profit?

sa: वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यं त्वमिच्छसि पार्थिव। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं रुद्रस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: O king, now ask the boon you desire," Hearing these words of the immeasurably effulgent Rudra (Shiva). The royal sage bowed to him and thus replied to him,

sa: यत्राददः सहस्राणि अयुतानां गवां दश। अनन्तरं सहस्रेण तदाऽऽसीद् दैन्य का मतिः॥
en: Formerly, engaged in sacrifice, you had gone round the whole Earth, following the rule of the hurling of the Shamya. What was the state of your mind then?

sa: अश्वत्थामोवाच नैव न्याय्यमिदं वाच्यमस्माकं पुरुषर्षभ। किं तु रोषपरीतेन गुरुणा भाषिता गुणाः॥
en: Ashvatthama said O foremost of men, the words that you have spoken to us are all just. The preceptor, filled with anger, has dilated upon his (Arjuna's) accomplishments.

sa: प्रस्वापमस्त्रं त्वरितो वचनाद् ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। विचित्रं च तदस्त्रं मे मनसि प्रत्यभात् तदा॥
en: That weapon Prasvapa speedily, according to the words of command of the speakers of Brahma. And the Mantras also for using that weapon suddenly came to my mind.

sa: या सा समृद्धिः पार्थानामिन्द्रप्रस्थे बभूव ह। राजसूये मया दृष्टा नृपैरन्यैः सुदुर्लभा॥
en: “I beheld the prosperity of the sons of Pritha at Indraprastha, on the occasion of the Rajasuya sacrifice, which could not even painfully be obtained by other kings.

sa: स तु सार्थो महान् राजन् कस्मिंश्चिद् गिरिगह्वरे। मत्तेन द्विरदेनाथ निहतः प्रायशोऽभवत्॥
en: It so took place, however, O king, that large caravan was attacked, while passing through a mountain valley, by an infuriate elephant. Almost all the persons were killed.

sa: न तथा ते करिष्यन्ति सेनाकर्म न संशयः। एतत् प्रयोजनं चात्र प्राधान्येनोपलभ्यते॥
en: While you are still there and their men are delaying, they no doubt will not be able to make preparations. This is necessary and here it seems imperative.

sa: कच्चिद् राजा धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रो बुभूषते वृत्तिममात्यवर्गे। कच्चिन्न भेदेन जिजीविषन्ति सुहृदूपा दुर्हदैश्चैकमत्यात्।।
en: Dose the king Dhritarashtra with his sons make provisions for his group of ministers. Are there no enemies in the disguise of well wishers combined for their ruin?

sa: यथान्यायं महातेजा मानी धर्मभृतां वरः। उत्समयन् प्रणतः प्राह कुन्तीं वैकर्तनो वृषः॥
en: As was custom that best among men, the son of Vikartana, endued with great energy and pride, that foremost of all virtuous persons, with surprise, said to Kunti.

sa: अथ स्वर्गस्तथा रूपी ब्राह्मणं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। संसिद्धस्त्वं महाभाग त्वं च सिद्धस्तथा नृप॥
en: Heaven, in his embodied form, came there. Addressing the Brahmana, he said,-You have acquired Success. You highly blessed.-Then addressing the king, said,-You have also, O king acquired success.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्रोक्ता गृहस्थवृत्तिस्ते विहिता या मनीषिभिः। तदनन्तरमुक्तं यत् तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said You have been told what the duties of a householders are as ordained by the wise. Listen now, O Yudhisthira, to the next class of duties.

sa: भ्राता तव महाराज देवदेवः सनातनः। धारणान्मनसा ध्यानाद् यं धर्मं कवयो विदुः॥
en: A deity of deities, and eternal, he was, O king, your brother. The learned know him to be Dharma on account of his practices of concentration and abstraction.

sa: किमियं पूर्वमेवेह न दत्ता मम गालवा पुत्रा ममैव चत्वारो भवेयुः कुलभावनाः॥
en: "Why was not this girl presented to me beforehand, OGalava? Then would all the four sons have been mine, every one of whom would have perpetuated a dynasty.

sa: सुप्यतां पाथ्र भद्रं ते कल्याणाय व्रजाम्यहम्। स्थापयित्वा ततो द्वा:स्थान् गोप्तुंश्चात्तायुधान् नरान्॥६
en: “O son of Pritha, lay yourself down for sleep; good betide you, I go in search of your welfare.” Then placing at the door well-armed sentinels and door-keepers.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः। ऊर्ध्वरेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मं तप उपागमत्॥
en: It came to pass that at this time, an ascetic named Culi, highly effulgent, with his vital fluid under control, and of pure practices, was performing Brāhma austerities.

sa: के च तत्र सभास्तारा राजानो ब्रह्मवित्तम। के चैनमन्वमोदन्त के चैनं प्रत्यषेधयन्॥
en: O best of all Veda-knowing men, who were the kings that were present in that Sabha and who amongst them approved of the play and who forbade it?

sa: अथाब्रवीद् बाहुकस्तं संख्याय मे बिभीतकम्। ततो विदर्भान् यास्यामि कुरुष्वैवं वचो मम॥
en: Thereupon Bahuka answered him, saying: "Having counted the (leaves and fruits of) Vibhitaka tree. I shall go to the country of the Vidharbhas. Act up to my words."

sa: त्वत्प्रसादान् महादेव तपो मे न क्षरेत वै। ततो देवः प्रहृष्टात्मा ब्रह्मर्षिमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: “O god of gods, grant me your grace, so that my asceticism may not diminish.” Thereupon the deity, becoming glad in heart, thus spoke to that Brahmana Rishi,

sa: दीर्घबाहू विशालाक्षौ शरश्चापासिधारिणौ। कस्य स स्याद् भयं दृष्ट्वा ह्येतौ सुरसुतोपमौ ॥
en: Who is not terrified beholding those two mighty armed heroes, having expansive eyes, with bows, arrow, and daggers in their hands like to two sons of a celestial?

sa: त्वं प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालं कालविदा वर। फुल्लसप्तच्छदश्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरच्छुभा॥
en: O you foremost of those conversant with time, the auspicious autumn, green with Saptchada flowers, has set in and you, given up to enjoyments, does not perceive it.

sa: अहमग्निः कुरुश्रेष्ठा मया दग्धं च खाण्डवम्। अर्जुनस्य प्रभावेण तथा नारायणस्य च॥
en: Oforemost ones of Kuru's race, I am the God of Fire. The forest of Khandava was burnt by me, through the power of Arjuna and of Narayana himself.

sa: वार्यतां साध्वयं मूढः शमं गच्छतु ते सुतः। वनस्थांस्तानयं हन्तुमिच्छन् प्राणान् विमोक्ष्यति॥
en: Let the fool be checked; let your son remain quiet. In attempting to kill them (the Pandavas) now living in the forest, he will loose his own life.

sa: अमोघं दर्शनं मह्यमाहूतश्चास्मि ते शुभे। वृथाह्यानेऽपि ते भीरु दोषः स्यान्नात्र संशयः॥
en: O amiable girl, my approach is infallible; it must be fruitful. O timid maiden, if my coming be for nothing, it will be certainly a transgression of yours.”

sa: कुन्त्युवाच कश्चिन्मे ब्राह्मणः प्रादाद्वरं विद्यां च शत्रुहन्। तद्विजिज्ञासयाऽऽह्वानं कृतवत्यस्मि ते विभो॥
en: Kunti said: O slayer of foes, a certain Brahmana gave। me this science (Mantra). O Lord, I have invoked you, only to see the efficacy of the Mantra.

sa: नैते शक्रेण नान्येन यमेन वरुणेन वा। शक्यन्ते वशमानेतुं तथैव धनदेन च।।४!
en: By Shakra, by Yama or by Varuna or by any body clse they were incapable of being brought inder subjugation; as also by the Lord of wealth (Kubera).

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र फलकीवनमुत्तमम्। तत्र देवाः सदा राजन् फलकीवनमाश्रिताः॥ तपश्चरन्ति विपुलं बहु वर्षसहस्रकम्। दृषद्वत्यां नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयित्वा च देवताः॥ अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलं विन्दति भारत। तीर्थे च सर्वदेवानां स्नात्वा भरतसत्तम॥ गोसहस्रस्य राजेन्द्र फलं विन्दति मानवः। पाणिखाते नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयित्वा च देवताः॥ अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलं विन्दति भारत। राजसूयमवाप्नोति ऋषिलोकं च विन्दति॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha of Falaki. O king, there the celestials are always present in Falakivana. And they undergo there great asceticism for many years together. Bathing then in the Drishadvati and worshipping the celestials, a man obtains fruits superior to those of both the Agnishtoma and Atiratha (sacrifices). O descendant of Bharata, bathing in the Tirtha called Sarvadeva a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. O king of kings, Bathing in the Panikhata and worshipping there the celestials, a mano descendant of Bharata, obtains fruits superior to those of Agnishtoma and Atiratha. He also obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and goes to the region of the Rishis.

sa: उपर्युपरि राज्ञां हि तव लोका युधिष्ठिर। हरिश्चन्द्रसमाः पार्थ येषु त्वं विहरिष्यसि॥
en: Your region, O Yudhishthira, are above, far above, those of kings. They are equal to those of Harishchandra, O son of Pritha. Come and sport there in bliss!

sa: कपीनां किल लालमिष्टं भवति भूषणम्। तदस्य दीप्यतां शीघ्रं तेन दग्धेन गच्छतु॥
en: Certainly the tail is a darling ornament to a monkey. Therefore let his tail be set on fire anon; and this having been consumed, let him go away.

sa: विराटस्य प्रियो भ्राता शतानीको निपातितः। शतानीकं च समरे हत्वा भीष्मः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then reducing in number all the divisions led by rulers of earth, Bhishma slew Shatanika the dear-loved brother of Virata. Having slain Shatanika in battle, the valiant Bhishma.

sa: सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा स्वर्गलोके महीयते। मानुषस्य तु पूर्वेण क्रोशमात्रे महीपते॥ आपगा नाम विख्याता नदी सिद्धनिषेविता। श्यामाकं भोजने तत्र यः प्रयच्छन्ति मानवः॥ देवान् पितृन् समुद्दिश्य तस्यधर्मफलं महत्। एकस्मिन् भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता॥
en: One is freed from all sins; and becoming pure souled he is adored in the region of Brahma. O ruler of men, in the east of Manusha, only a kosa from it. There is a celebrated river named Apaga which is ever frequented by the Siddhas. The man who offers there Shyamaka food. To the celestials and the Pitris secures great virtuous merit. One Brahmana svd there is equal to million of Brahmanas fed.

sa: ततो रथं युगेषां च च्छित्त्वा भल्लैः सुसंयतैः॥ अश्वांस्तस्यावधीत् तूर्णमूभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी।
en: Then cutting off his car and the shaft of that car with many well-aimed arrows, Satyaki quickly killed the horses of his antagonist and his two Parshni drivers.

sa: शरप्रतप्तः स तु नागराज: प्रवेपिताङ्गो व्यथितान्तरात्मा। संसीदमानो निपपात मह्यां वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य॥
en: Struck by the arrow that elephant-chief, greatly pained began to tremble; and being cxhausted, it fell down on the earth like a nountain summit clapped by a thunderbolt.

sa: स्वर्णशृङ्गी च कपिला सवत्सां वस्त्रसंवृताम्। वाचकाय च दद्याद्धि आत्मनः श्रेय इच्छता॥
en: One desirous of one's own behoot should give to the reciter a Kapila cow with horns cased in gold and accompanied by her calf, covered with a cloth.

sa: स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थे महारथः। निषसाद महाराज कश्मलं च जगाम ह॥
en: Thus deeply pierced, and smarting with pain, that mighty car-warrior squatted down on the terrace of his car, and O mighty monarch he was overwhelmed with a swoon.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं तव राजेन्द्र राजसूये यथाऽभवत्। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेश द्युते च परुषा गिरः॥
en: It was in your presence, O chief among kings, namely what happened in the Rajasuya. The sufferings of Draupadi and the harsh words at the game of vice,

sa: ततो हि वदतां तेषामश्रौष्म विपुलं ध्वनिम्॥ बलिः किलोपहियते तस्य देवस्य तैनरैः।
en: We then heard a very loud noise uttered by all of them together. It appeared that those men were engaged in offering a sacrifice to the great God.

sa: भवनं च महेन्द्रस्य कुबेरस्य च धीमतः। वरुणस्य तथा लोकान् विविशुः पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Those foremost of men have gone, some to the abode of Indra, some to that of highly intelligent Kubera of great intelligence, and some to that of Varuna.

sa: तथा ब्रूवन्तं तमहं रामं पुरपुरंजयम्। नैतदेवं पुनर्भावि ब्रह्मर्षे किं श्रमेण ते॥
en: I said to Rama, the conqueror of hostile cites who was speaking thus: “This will not be, O regenerate Rishi, what is the use of labouring towards it.

sa: नरनारायणौ यौ तौ पूर्वदेवौ विभावसो। सम्प्राप्तौ मानुषे लोके कार्यार्थं हि दिवौकसाम्॥
en: O Vibhavasu, the two old dcities Nara and Narayana have become incarnates in the world of men to accomplish the purposes of the dwellers of heaven (the celestial).

sa: मानसो नाम स जपो जप्यते तैर्महात्मभिः॥ तेनैकाग्रमनस्त्वेन प्रीतो भवति वै हरिः।
en: The recitation performed by those great persons was a mental Yapa. On account of their hearts, having been entirely fixed upon Him, Hari became highly gratified with them.

sa: तस्यैवं ब्रुवतो राजा मन्दासुर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। किं शक्यमिह कर्तुं वै कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: As he was speaking thus, the king, whose sounds were fast running out said: 'What can I do in this matter. Verily time is incapable of being controlled.

sa: मृते मयि गते रामे वनं मनुजपुङ्गवे। हन्तानार्ये ममामित्रे सकामा सुखिनी भव॥
en: O ignoble one! O enemy of mine! On my being dead and that chief of men, Rāma, repairing to the woods, do you, yours wish attained, become happy.

sa: न चैव मामकं किंचित् हृष्टं शंससि संजय। नित्यं पाण्डुसुतान् हृष्टानभग्नान् सम्प्रशंससि॥
en: But, O Sanjaya, you never speak of my soldiers being delightful (on such occasion). You always speak of the warriors of the Pandavas as cheerful and never routed.

sa: न ह्यहं मनसाप्यन्यं गच्छेयं त्वदृते नरम्। त्वत्तः प्रतिविशिष्टश्च कोऽन्योऽस्ति भुवि मानवः॥
en: I shall not certainly, even in imagination, accept any other man except you in my embrace. Who is there in this world who could be superior to you?

sa: स राजा पतितो भूमौ विह्वलः प्रविवेपितः। वज्रदग्ध इवारण्ये सालो निपतितो यथा॥
en: The king, deprived of his senses, fell down on the earth, with his body trembling all over; as falls in a forest a sāla scathed with heaven's fire.

sa: गाण्डीवं च धनुर्दिव्यं ते चाश्वा वातरंहसः। अभेद्यं कवचं दिव्यमक्षय्यौ च महेषुधी॥
en: He has the celestial bow Gandiva and horses that have the speed of wind, celestial coat of mail which is impenetrable and great arrow holders which are inexhaustible;

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो गङ्गा सुतस्नेहाद् भीष्मं पुनरुपागमत्। न चास्याश्चाकरोद् वाक्यं क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Ganga, out of affection for her son, come again to Bhishma but he with eyes expanded with wrath did not attend to her words.

sa: शुक्र उवाच यत् किंचिदस्ति द्रविणं दैत्येन्द्राणां महासुर। तस्येश्वरोऽस्मि यद्येषा देवयानी प्रसाद्यताम्॥
en: Shukra said: Ogreat Asura, if it is (really) true that I am the lord over all the wealth of the Asuras, then go and try to please Devayani.

sa: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातको। सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षों सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥ प्रचेतसोऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन। न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ॥
en: I tell you the truth, O Råma, that these irrepressible twin brothers are your sons, O descendant of Raghu. I am the tenth son of Pracetā, so, far from speaking untruth it does not even spring up in my mind. I therefore know the truth that these twins are your sons.

sa: श्रोता चार्थस्य विदुरस्त्वं च वक्ता जनार्दन। कमिवार्थं निवर्तन्तं स्थापयेतां न वर्मनि॥
en: When you, O Janardana, speak and Vidura hears on subjects conducive to their interests; what subject is there in the world which you cannot turn smooth and clear.

sa: ततो भित्त्वैव गगनं प्रविष्टो रश्मिमण्डलम्। एकीभूतं च तत् तेजः क्षणेनादित्यतां गतम्॥
en: The latter the then, piercing through the sky, entered into the Sun's disc. Mingling then with the Sun's energy, he seemed to be changed into the Sun's self.

sa: जगत्यां पुरुषव्याघ्र आस्ते वीरासने रतः। जनेन्द्रो निर्जनं प्राप्य धिङ्मे जन्म सजीवितम्॥
en: That foremost of men in all the world, the lord of all, coming into seclusion, is in his yoga posture. O fie upon my birth and my life!

sa: ततो दीनमना भीष्ममुवाच कुरुसत्तमः। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां पादौ तस्य शनैः स्पृशन्॥ श्व इदानीं स्वसन्देहं प्रक्ष्यामि त्वां पितामह। उपैति सविता शस्तं रसमापीय पार्थिवम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira, that chief of Kuru's race, with a depressed heart and eyes bathed in tears, gently touched Bhishma's feet and said,—'O grandsire, I shall tomorrow enquire after those points about which I have my doubts, for today the sun, having sucked the moisture of the earth, is about to set.

sa: निविष्टा हि पुरी लङ्का तीरे नदनदीपतेः॥ कथं ज्ञास्यति तां रामस्तत्रस्थां तामनिन्दिताम्।
en: The city of Lankā is situated on the shores of the lord of rivers and streams. How can Rāma get a knowledge of that blameless one, staying there?

sa: न च ते भ्रातरः पार्थ नरकारे विशाम्पते। मायैषा देवराजेन महेन्द्रेण प्रयोजिता॥
en: O son of Pritha, your brothers, O king, were not such as to deserve Hell. All this has been an illusion created by the king of the celestials.

sa: स्वनाम नामा दुर्धर्षो द्वितीयो हेमपर्वतः। द्युतिमान् नाम कौरव्य तृतीयः कुमुदो गिरिः॥
en: It is called after the island, this mountain is made of gold and it is inaccessible. O descendant of Kuru, there is another greatly effulgert mountain called Kumuda.

sa: जानामि काम त्वां चैव यच्च किंचित् प्रियं तव। तवाहं प्रियमन्विच्छन्नात्मन्युपलभे सुखम्॥
en: I know you, O Desire, and all those things that are dear to you. Seeking what is dear to you, I shall feel happiness in my own Self.

sa: दिव्यं च ब्रह्मचर्येण लिङ्गमस्य यथा स्थितम्। महयत्येष लोकांश्च महेश्वर इति स्मृतः॥
en: As his Phallic form is ever present in the observance of the Brahmacharya vow and as it adds to the glory of the world, he is called Maheshvara.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्तः स विप्रस्तु धर्मव्याधेन भारत। कथामकथयद् भूयो मनसः प्रीतिवधनीम्॥
en: Markandeya said : O descendant of Bharata, having been thus addressed by that Brahmana, the virtuous fowler again began to speak (on things) so pleasing to the mind.

sa: कूजतां क्रन्दतां चैव रस्तनतां चैव भारत। अनिशं शुश्रुवै शब्दः क्षुत्क्लिष्टानां नृणामिव॥
en: They gleaned and moaned and cries and uttered cries of agony in consequence of which a confused noise was heard, resembling that produced by men struck with famine.

sa: तत्र वै वायवो वान्ति दिग्भ्यः सर्वाभ्य एव हि॥ असम्बद्धा महाराज तान् निगृह्णन्ति ते गजाः। पुष्करैः पद्मसंकाशैविकसद्भिर्महाप्रभैः॥ शतधा पुनरेवाशु ते तान् मुञ्चन्ति नित्यशः।
en: O king, winds blow in these regions irregularly from all directions. These winds are scized by these elephants with the tips of their trunks, which are like to lotus in complexion, which are very bright and which they are capable of drawing up in this way. As soon as they scize them, they let them out.

sa: इन्द्रियाणां प्रसृष्टानां हयानामिव वर्त्मसु। धृतिं कुर्वीत सारथ्ये धृत्या तानि जयेद् ध्रुवम्॥
en: When our senses become ungovernable like horses on the road, we must patiently rein them in, for with patience we are sure to get the better of them.

sa: श्रुत्वा यः सुहृदां शास्त्रं मर्यो न प्रतिपद्यते। विपाकान्ते दहत्येनं किम्पाकमिव भक्षितम्॥
en: That man, who hearing the advice of his friends, does not act according to it, in the end is consumed like one who has eaten the Kimpaka fruit.

sa: सांनिध्यं तत्र राजेन्द्र रुद्रपल्याः कुरूद्वह। अभिगम्य च तां देवीं न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: O king of kings, O perpetuator of the Kuru race, the wife of Rudra is also present there. He who beholds that goddess never meets with any calamity.

sa: अमन्यत महाबाहुः कर्म तद् यक्षरक्षसाम्। स चिन्तयामास तदा योद्धव्यं ध्रुवमद्य वै॥
en: That mighty-armed one considered (within himself). “This act must have been done by some Yaksha or Rakshasa." And he thought (further) “I will have surely to fight today.

sa: इति लोकसमानुष्टः पादेष्वद्य प्रसादयन्। रामं तस्य पतिष्यामि सीताया लक्ष्मणस्य च ॥
en: I shall be taxed of men on the score. To-day (first) pacifying him, I will fall at the feet of Rāma as well as of Sitã and Lakşmaņa.

sa: तानाह उपाध्याय:-'मयोपमन्युः सर्वतः प्रतिषिद्धः स नियतं कुपितस्ततो नागच्छति चिरं ततोऽन्वेष्यः' इत्येवमुक्त्वा शिष्यैः सार्धमरण्यं गत्वा तस्याह्वानाय शब्दं चकार-'भो उपमन्यो! क्वासि वत्स! एहि' इति॥
en: On this the preceptor said, Upamanyu is displeased, because he has been prevented from the use of everything. He is therefore, making late to come home. Let us go and find him out." Having said this, he went with his pupils into the forest and called aloud. “Ho, Upamanyu, where are you? My child, come here."

sa: साधुगम्यमहं मार्गं न जातु त्वत्कृते पुनः। गच्छेयं तद् गमिष्यामि हित्वा ग्राम्यसुखान्युत॥
en: Abandoning all earthly pleasure, I shall follow that path which is trod by the righteous! [ shall not, for your sake, follow the path pointed out by you.

sa: संजय उवाच सम्प्राद्रवत्सु दारेषु क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्। विदुते शिबिरे शून्ये भृशोद्विग्नास्त्रयो रथाः॥
en: Sanjaya said After the flight of the ladies of those great Kshatriyas and after the Kaurava camp had become entirely empty, the three car-warriors were stricken with anxiety.

sa: सर्वसंग्रहणे युक्तो नृपो भवति यः सदा। उत्थानशीलो मित्राढ्यः स राजा राजसत्तमः॥
en: That king, who always tries to win over men to himself, who is ready for work, who is rich in friends and allies, becomes the foremost of king.

sa: इदं मम महद् दुःखं वर्तते हृदि नित्यदा। कृत्वा ज्ञातिक्षयमिमं महान्तं लोभकारितम्॥ सौभद्रं द्रौपदेयांश्च घातयित्वा सुतान् प्रियान्। जयोऽयमजयाकारो भगवन् प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: But his heavy grief, is always preying on my mind, that through covetousness I have brought about this dreadful destruction of kinsmen. Having caused the death of the darling son of Subhadra, and of the sons of Draupadi, this victory, O Holy one, appears to me as being tantamount to defeat.

sa: एवं तां क्षत्रियस्याहुः पुराणाः परमां गतिम्। शस्त्रेण निधनं संख्ये तत्र शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Death in battle by weapons has been described by the ancients as the best that a Kshatriya can obtain. You should not, therefore, grieve for any of them.

sa: के वानुरक्ताः राजानः के भयात् समुपाश्रिताः। मध्यस्थदोषाः के चैषामिति नित्यं विचिन्तयेत्॥
en: You should always determine who amongst the dependent kings is truly devoted to you, and who is loyal to you from fear, and who amongst them has faults.

sa: ताभ्यां सम्भूय कर्तव्यं प्रजानां परिपालनम्। तथा च मां प्रवर्तन्तं किं गर्हस्यलकाधिप।॥
en: Helped by both kinds of strength, kings should protect their subjects. I am acting in that way. Why do you, O lord of Alaka, remonstrate with me then?

sa: आरण्यकान् प्रव्रजितान् ब्राह्मणान् परिपूजयन्। अपि तेभ्यो गृहान् गत्वा निनाय सततं वने।॥
en: arrows He showed great reverence for those Brahmanas who had retired from the world for living in the forest. Killing the deer, he often took meat to them.

sa: दत्त्वाभयं स्वयं राजा प्रमाणं कुरुते यदि। स सर्वसुखकृज्ज्ञेयः प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: On the other hand, that king, who, having given hopes of protection, fulfils them, is honoured as a universal benefactor in consequence of his protecting all his subjects.

sa: ये च केचन लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्थाः संशयकारकाः। तेषां छेत्ता नास्ति लोके त्वदन्यः पुरुषर्षभ।॥
en: Except you, O foremost of men, there is no other person that can dispell the doubts that may arise regarding the subjects of knowledge studied in the world.

sa: उत्साहश्च कृतो नित्यं मया दिष्ट्या युयुत्सता। दिष्ट्या चास्मिन् हतो युद्धे निहतज्ञातिबान्धवः॥
en: By good luck, while engaged in hostilities, I always showed courage and perseverance. By good luck, I am killed in battle, along with all my relatives and friends.

sa: न वाच्यः परिवादोऽयं न श्रोतव्यः कथञ्चन। कर्णावथ पिधातव्यौ प्रस्थेयं चान्यतो भवेत्॥
en: Slander should never be circulated. If spoken, it should never be heard. When any slanderous conversation goes on, one should close one's ears or leave the place immediately.

sa: एतद् राज्ञो दिलीपस्य राजानो नानुचक्रिरे। यस्येभा हेमसंछन्नाः पथि मत्ताः स्म शेरते॥
en: No other king could imitate the deeds of king Dilipa. The elephants of that king, intoxicated and adorned with golden trappings used to lie down on the roads.

sa: ब्रह्मवृक्षो रक्ष्यमाणो मधु हेम च वर्षति। अरक्ष्यमाण: सततमश्रु पापं च वर्षति॥
en: If the tree of a Brahmana is protected, it showers gold and honey. If on the other hand, it is not protected, it then showers tears and sin.

sa: ते वयं स्वर्गमिच्छन्तः संग्रामे त्यक्तजीविताः। जयन्तो वध्यमाना वा प्राप्नुयाम च सद्गतिम्॥
en: Determined upon acquiring heaven we should fight not caring for life itself, and prepared to conquer or die, and we would attain then a blessed end in heaven!

sa: स एष तद् वैरमनुस्मरन वै त्वां प्रार्थयत्यात्मवधाय नूनम्। नभश्चयुतां प्रज्वलितामिवोल्का पश्यैनमायान्तममित्रसाह॥
en: Remembering that hostility, O Partha, he has come today for slaying you. O grinder of enemies, see he is coursing like a burning firebrand droops from the sky.

sa: धर्मचर्या च राज्यं च नित्यमेव विरुध्यते। एवं मुह्याति मे चेतश्चिन्तयानस्य नित्यशः॥
en: The practice of virtue and the performance of royal duties are always inconsistent with each other. I am always perplexed to think how one may reconcile the two.

sa: ध्रुवं येयमधर्मे में प्रवृत्ता कलुषा मतिः॥ तस्याः फलमिदं घोरं प्रतिघाताय कल्पते।
en: Forsooth, that being is the dreadful outcome of this my sinful determination which I had attempted to achieve by unfair means, He stands there for baffling my resolution.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच एकैकेन च मां यूयमासीद् युधिष्ठिर। न ह्येको बहुभिाय्यो वीरो योधयितुं युधि॥ न्यस्तवर्मा विशेषेण श्रान्तश्चाप्सु परिप्लुतः। भृशं विक्षतगात्रश्च हतवाहनसैनिकः॥
en: Duryodhana said You will have, O Yudhishthira, to meet me one at a time. It is not meet that one hero should fight with many at the same time, especially when he is divested of armour, worn out with fatigue, covered with water, greatly wounded and without cars, animals and troops.

sa: शून्ये च तमुपादाय पक्षिणं समजातकम्। हत्वा ततः स राजेन्द्र धात्र्या हस्तमुपागतः॥
en: At length, raising the bird which was to the same age with himself with his hands, the prince pressed it to death and then returned to his nurse.

sa: क्रियाभ्युपायैर्बहुभिर्हिरण्याक्षो महासुरः॥ हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव क्रिययैव निषूदितौ। वृत्रश्च निहतो राजन् क्रिययैव न संशयः॥
en: The great Asura Hiranyaksha, as also that one, viz., Hiranyakashipu, was killed by the same power. Forsooth, O king, Vritra also was slain by the power of illusion.

sa: अवेक्षस्व यथा स्वैः स्वैः कर्मभिर्व्यापृतं जगत्। तस्मात् कर्मव कर्तव्यं नास्ति सिद्धिरकर्मणः॥
en: Behold, the world moves on, with every creature on it acting according to its nature, therefore, one should act. The man shorn of action can never attain success.

sa: जयं जानीत धर्मस्य मूलं सर्वसुखस्य च। या भीरूणां परा ग्लानिः शूरस्तामधिगच्छति॥
en: Know that victory is the source of religious merit and of every sort of happiness. The heroes bear cheerfully what is regarded as the highest misery by cowards.

sa: कुलं वंशश्च पिण्डाश्च यच्च पुत्रकृतं फलम्॥ गान्धार्यास्तव वै नाथ पाण्डवेषु प्रतिष्ठितम्।
en: The perpetuity of race, the offering of funeral cake, and every thing else that depends upon offspring, now depend on the Pandavas as regards both yourself and Gandhari.

sa: अगतिश्च गतिश्चैव लोकस्य विदिता तव। आयत्यां च तदात्वे च न तेऽस्त्यविदितंप्रभो॥
en: The fair and unfair paths of the world are known to you. Everything belonging either to the future or the present is known to you, O powerfiil one.

sa: न चाप्येतान् हतान् युद्धे राजशोचितुमर्हसि। प्रमाणं यदि शास्त्राणि गतास्ते परमां गतिम्॥
en: O king, you should not grieve for those who have been killed in battle. If the scriptures are authoritative all of them must have obtained the highest end.

sa: पुत्रगृद्ध्या त्वया राजन् प्रियं तस्य चिकीर्षितम्। पश्चात्तापमिमं प्राप्तो न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Out of affection for your son, O king, you did what was agreeable to Duryodhana. You are obliged to repent for that now. You should not, however, grieve.

sa: स मृगो बाणमादाय यथामितविक्रमः। स च राजा बलात् तूर्णं ससार मृगयूथपम्॥
en: Endued with great strength, the deer ran ahead, with the arrow sticking to him. The king was equally powerful, and accordingly pursued his precious game with great speed.

sa: आपत्सु च यथा नीतिः प्रणेतव्या द्विजोत्तम। धर्म्यमालक्ष्य पन्थानं विजयेयं कथं महीम्॥
en: I wish to hear, O foremost of Brahmanas, how persons should behave in times of distress, and how I may subjugate the world by following path of morality.

sa: न शोचन् मृतमन्वेति न शोचन म्रियते नरः। एवं सांसिद्धिके लोके किमर्थमनुशोचसि॥
en: By grieving one cannot get back the dead. By indulging in grief, one cannot die himself. When such is the course of the world, why do you grieve?

sa: शीतांशुश्चन्द्र इत्युक्ते लोके को विस्पयिष्यति। तथैव यशसा पूर्णे मयि को विस्मयिष्यति॥
en: Who on Earth will wonder if the Moon be said possessing cool rays? Similarly, who will wonder if I were described as one endued with the greatest fame.

sa: मुचुकुन्द उवाच नाहं राज्यं भवद्दत्तं भोक्तुमिच्छामि पार्थिव। बाहुवीर्यार्जितं राज्यम श्नीयामिति कामये॥
en: I do not, O king, desire to enjoy sovereignty given by you as a gift. I desire to enjoy sovereignty secured by the power of my own arms.

sa: दत्त्वा च ते सुखप्रश्नं सर्वे यान्ति यथागतम्। ग्राम्यस्त्वेकः पशुस्तत्रनाजहात् स महामुनिम्॥
en: Coming to him they made enquiries, and then went away to their respective habitations. One domestic animal, however, resided there permanently, never, leaving the ascetic at any time.

sa: पूर्वे वयसि मध्ये वाप्युत्तरे वा नराधिप। अवर्जनीयास्तेऽर्था वै कांक्षिता ये ततोऽन्यथा॥
en: The evils of life, O king, overtake one in infancy or youth or old age. They can never be avoided, while those which one seeks most never come.

sa: नैतत् कारणमल्पं हि भविष्यति विशाम्पते। यदेकस्मिन् जगत् सर्वं देववद् याति संनतिम्॥
en: O king, there must be some mighty reason for all this because it is seen that the whole world bows down to one man as to a god.'

sa: एवं विद्वान् महाप्राज्ञः समर्थः सन् बलाबले। आत्मापराधात् कस्मात् त्वं कुरुषे कोपमीदृशम्॥
en: You are learned wise and can understand strength and weakness. Why are you then angry when all that has befallen you is the outcome of your own folly.

sa: यस्त्वं त्रैविद्यवृद्धानां ब्राह्मणानां सहस्रशः। भर्ता भूत्वा च लोकस्य सोऽद्य तै तिमिच्छसि॥
en: You, before this, supported thousands of Brahmanas versed in the three Vedas and many more others. How can you desire to beg of them your own food today.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आसन् पूर्वयुगे राजन् मुनयो भ्रातरस्त्रयः॥ एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चादित्य संनिभाः।
en: Vaishampayana said In a former cycle, O king, there were three ascetic brothers. They were called Ekata, Dvita and Trita and all three were effulgent like the sun.

sa: एवं संचिन्त्य यो याति तिथिनक्षत्रपूजितः। विजयं लभते नित्यं सेना सम्यक् प्रयोजयन्।
en: That king, who, having attended to all these points, marches, under a proper constellation and an auspicious luminary, always succeeds in acquiring victory by properly leading his troops.

sa: भेदे गणा विनेशुर्हि भिन्नास्तु सुजयाः परैः। तस्मात् संघातयोगेन प्रयतेरन् गणा: सदा॥
en: If again the aristocracy of a kingdom are divided, they meet with destruction. Disunited, they are easily ruined by their foes. The nobles, therefore, should always act unitedly.

sa: भ्रातृसौहृदमास्थाय यदुक्तं वचनं त्वया। न्याय्यं युक्तं च कौन्तेय प्रीतोऽहं तेन तेऽर्जुन॥
en: What, however, you have said to me out of fraternal affection, has been fit and proper, O son of Kunti. I am, therefore, gratified with thee, O Arjuna.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ब्राह्मणास्तात लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्चनीयाः सदा मम। एते भूमिचरा देवा वाग्विषाः सुप्रसादकाः॥
en: Vasudeva said In this world, O friend, I adore only the Brahmanas. They are gods on Earth, have venom in their words, and are exceedingly easy to gratify.

sa: अथ स्म कर्मणा केन लोकान् जयति पार्थिवः। विद्वन् जिज्ञासमानाय प्रबूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: By what acts then does the king acquire blessed regions? O foremost of Bharata's race, enlighten me on this, O learned one, I am as anxious to know.

sa: चिन्तयित्वा वयस्तेषां बालक्रीडां च संजय। हतान् पुत्रानशेषेण दीर्यते मे भृशं मनः॥
en: Thinking of their ages, O Sanjaya and of their sports in childhood and learning today that all of them have died, my heart seems to break into pieces!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं व्यासो योगविदां वरः। युधिष्ठिरं महाप्राज्ञो धर्मज्ञो वेदपारगः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed, the virtuous Vyasa, the best of all persons conversant with Yoga, endued with great wisdom and a master of the Vedas, said to Yudhishthira.

sa: ब्रह्म वक्त्रं भुजौ क्षत्रं कृत्स्नमूरूदरं विशः। पादौ यस्याश्रिताः शूद्रास्तस्मै वर्णात्मने नमः॥
en: Brahmanas are your mouth, Kshatriyas are your two arms., Vaishyas are your stomach and thighs, and Shudras are your feet. Salutations to you in your form of caste.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आश्रमाणां महाबाहो शृणु सत्यपराक्रम। चतुर्णामपि नामानि कर्माणि च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said O mighty-armed one, hear me, O you of prowess incapable of being baffled, as I name the four modes of life and describe their respective duties.

sa: अतिधर्माद् बलं मन्ये बलाद् धर्मः प्रवर्तते। बले प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो धरण्यामिव जङ्गमम्॥
en: If, however, the two be compared, Power will appear as superior to Righteousness. From Power originates Righteousness. Righteousness depends upon Power as all immobile things upon the Earth.

sa: अवेक्षस्व यथा स्वैः स्वैः कर्मभिर्व्यापृतं जगत्। तस्मात् कर्मव कर्तव्यं नास्ति सिद्धिरकर्मणः॥
en: Behold, the world moves on, with every creature on it acting according to its nature, therefore, one should act. The man shorn of action can never attain success.

sa: तपः श्रेष्ठं प्रजानां हि मूलमेतन्न संशयः। कुटुम्बविधिनानेन यस्मिन् सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ एतद् विदुस्तपो विप्रा द्वन्द्वातीता विमत्सराः। तस्माद् व्रतं मध्यमं तु लोकेषु तप उच्यते॥
en: Forsooth, penances are the foremost of all things and are the root of all creatures, Asceticism, is attainable by leading the life a householder, upon which depends everything. The learned Brahmins having chack on malice, beyond the sphere of duality know that penance. The penance so observed by them is addressed as penance on the earth.

sa: जातवेदा यथा राजन् नादग्ध्वैवोपशाम्यति। सदैव याचमानो हि तथा शाम्यति न द्विजः॥
en: As a fire, o king, never dies till it has consumed all that has been thrown into it, even so a beggar is silenced till he receives something.

sa: सर्वकर्माणि कुरुते शूद्रवत् तस्य स द्विजः॥ सर्वकर्मेत्यभिख्यातः स मां रक्षतु पार्थिवः।
en: Though born in the family of a twice-born one, yet like a Shudra he does everything for that Rishi and has, therefore been named servant of all work.

sa: साह्यं तथा महाबाहो दत्तमस्माकमच्युत। सारथ्येन च वार्ष्णेय भवता हि धृता वयम्॥
en: Similarly, O mighty-armed one, you have helped us, O you of unfading glory. By agreeing to act as our charioteer, O Vrishnihero, you have all along protected us.

sa: ये न मानित्वमिच्छन्ति मानयन्ति च ये परान्। मान्यमानान् नमस्यन्ति दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who do not seek honour for themselves, who give honour to others, who bow down to those who deserve their adoration, succeed succeed in getting all difficulties.

sa: काममेष वरो मेऽस्तु शापो वाथ महेश्वरात्। न चान्यां देवता काइक्षे सर्वकामफलामपि॥
en: I wish to have boons or curses from Mahadeva. No, I shall not acknowledge any other god. Nor would I have my desires fulfilled from any other deity.

sa: ओषधीभिस्तथा ब्रह्मन् यजेरंस्ते न तादृशाः। इति त्यागं पुरस्कृत्य तादृशं प्रब्रवीमि ते॥
en: They, therefore, who are otherwise, should celebrate Sacrifices with herbs and plants, Because Renunciation has such merit, there I have kept it in view in speaking to you.

sa: सोऽसृजद् वातमग्निं च भास्करं चापि वीर्यवान्। आकाशमसृजच्चोर्ध्वमधो भूमिं च नैर्ऋतीम्॥ नभः सचन्द्रतारं च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहांस्तथा। संवत्सरानृतून् मासान् पक्षानथ लवान् क्षणान्॥
en: He then created wind, and fire, and the highly powerful sun. He also created the sky, the heavens, the nether regions, Earth, the quarters, the firmament with the moon and the stars, the constellations, the planets, the year, the seasons, the months, the two fortnights and the smaller divisions of time.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच सुरैरेव महाभागे पूर्वमेतदनुष्ठितम्। यज्ञेषु सर्वेषु मम न भाग उपकल्पितः॥
en: O highly blessed lady, the gods in days of yore made a compact by virtue of which no share was allotted to me of offerings in all Sacrifices.

sa: अनुग्रहानेवमेष करोति भगवान् विभुः। परं धाता विधाता च सुखदुःखे च सर्वदा॥
en: The illustrious and puissant Mahadeva favours all creatures in this way. He is always the great dispenser and ordainer of the happiness and sorrow of all living creatures.

sa: रूपं गन्धं रसं स्पर्श चैवाथ तद्गुणान्। इन्द्रियाणि न बुध्यन्ते क्षेत्रज्ञस्तैस्तु बुध्यते॥
en: These five properties, viz., form scent, taste, touch, and sound, are not really perceived by the senses, but it is the Soul that apprehends them through the senses.

sa: भीष्म उवाच उभौ धर्मो महाभागावुभौ परमदुश्चरौ। उभौ महाफलौ तौ तु सद्भिराचरितावुभौ॥
en: Bhishma said “Both courses of duty are highly sacred. Both are extremely difficult of performance. Both yield high fruits. Both are practised by those who are admittedly good.

sa: परं हि तद् ब्रह्म महन्महात्मन् ब्रह्माणमीशं वरदं च विष्णुम्। भवं च धर्मं च षडाननं च यद् ब्रह्मपुत्रांश्च महानुभावान्॥ तमश्च कष्टं सुमहद् रजश्च सत्त्वं विशुद्धं प्रकृति परां च। सिद्धिं च देवीं वरुणस्य पत्नी तेजश्च कृत्स्नं सुमहच्च धैर्यम्॥ ताराधिपं खे विमलं सतारं विश्वांश्च देवानुरगान् पितॄश्च। शैलांश्च कृत्स्नानुदधींश्च घोरान् नदीश्च सर्वाः सवनान् घनांश्च॥ नागान् नगान् यक्षगणान् दिशश्च गन्धर्व संघान् पुरुषान् स्त्रियश्च। परस्परं प्राप्य महान्महात्मा विशेत योगी न चिराद् विमुक्तः॥
en: That highest fruit is oneness with Brahma. The great Yogin, endued with greatness, can enter into, and come out of, at his will, Brahman himself who is the lord of all gods, and the born-giving Vishnu, and Bhava, and Dharma, and the six-faced Kartikeya, and the (spiritual) sons of Brahman, the quality of Darkness that is productive of much pain, and that of Ignorance, and that of Goodness which is pure, and Nature which is the highest, and the goddess Siddhi who is the wife of Varuna, and all sorts of energy, and all-enduring patience, and the bright lord of stars in the sky with the stars twinkling all around, and the Vishvas, and the snakes, and the Pitris, and all the mountains and hills, and the great and terrible oceans, and all the rivers, and the clouds charged with rain and serpent

sa: यत् प्राणः सर्वभूतानां वर्धन्ते येन च प्रजाः। परित्यक्ताश्च नश्यन्ति तेनेदं सर्वमावृतम्॥
en: Water is the life of all creatures, and it helps their growth. If there be no water, all creatures would die. The cntire universe is pervaded by water.

sa: अथ तं प्रमदाः प्राहुर्भगवान् प्रविशत्विति। स च तासां सुरूपाणां तस्यैव भवनस्य हि॥ कौतूहलं समाविष्टः प्रविवेश गृहं द्विजः। तत्रापश्यज्जरायुक्तामरजोऽम्बरधारिणीम्॥ वृद्धां पर्यङ्कमासीनां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम्। स्वस्तीति तेन चैवोक्ता सा स्त्री प्रत्यवदत् तदा॥ प्रत्युत्थाय च तं विप्रमास्यतामित्युवाच ह।
en: Those ladies then addressed the Rishi saying Let the illustrious one enter. Stricken with curiously about those highly beautiful ladies, as also of that palace the twiceborn Rishi entered as he was commanded. Entering the palace lie saw an old lady, with marks of decrepitude, dressed in white robes and adorned with every kind of ornament. The Rishi blessed her, saying Good be to you. The old lady returned his good wishes in due form, Rising up, she offered a seat to the Rishi.

sa: न ह्यल्पं दुष्कृतं नोऽस्ति येनाग्नि शमागतः। भवतां चाथवा मह्यं तत्त्वेनैतद् विमृश्यताम्॥
en: Indeed, we have committed a great iniquity for which Agni has thus disappeared! Either you have committed the sin, or I. Do you fully enquire into the matter.

sa: यथेष्टं गच्छ दैत्येन्द्र स्वस्ति तेऽसतु महासुर। आदित्यो नैव तपिता कदाचिन्मध्यत: स्थितः॥
en: Go wherever you like, O king of the Daityas! O great Asuras, peace to you! No time will come when the sun will shine from only the meridian.

sa: तस्मै सोऽथासनं दत्त्वा पाद्यमर्थ्य तथैव च। अब्रवीद् ब्राह्मणो वाक्यं कृत्वा कुशलसंविदम्॥
en: The Brahmana offered the king a seat, as also water to wash his feet, and the usual Arghya. Having next made the usual enquiries of courtesy, he said,-

sa: यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे सागरे यान्ति संस्थितम्। एवमाश्रमिणः सर्वे गृहस्थे यान्ति संस्थितिम्॥
en: Indeed, as all rivers, male and female, go in the end to the Ocean, so men belonging to all the other orders have the householders for their refuge.

sa: इत्थं हि दुश्चरो धर्म एष पार्थिवसत्तम। यथैव त्वं तथैवान्ये भवन्तीह विमोहिताः॥
en: O best of kings, this religion is, for these reasons, highly difficult of practice. Others, hearing it, become as much stupefied as you have allowed yourself to be.

sa: तथैवास्य भयाद् बद्ध्वा वसिष्ठः सलिले पुरा। आत्मानं मज्जयन् श्रीमान् विपाशः पुनरुत्थितः॥
en: From fear of Vishvamitra the glorious Vasishtha, in days of yore, binding himself with creepers, threw himself down into a river and again rose released from his fetters,

sa: क्षीरोदनं च भुञ्जीयामक्षयं सह बान्धवैः। आश्रमे च सदास्माकं सांनिध्यं परमस्तु ते॥
en: I shall also, with all my kinsmen and friends, always eat food mixed with milk. And let your illustrious self be for ever present at our gifted hermitage.

sa: पापानुबन्धं यत् कर्म यद्यपि स्यान्महाफलम्। तन्न सेवेत मेधावी शुचिः कुशलिनं यथा॥
en: The intelligent man would never do a sinful act even if it produce the greatest advantage, just as a person who is pure would never touch a Chandala.

sa: नाभिष्वजेत् परं वाचा कर्मणा मनसापि वा। उपेक्षको यताहारो लब्धालब्धे समो भवेत्॥
en: One should not mix with another in either speech, act or thought. Disregarding all things and eating very sparingly the Yogin should regard equally objects acquired or lost.

sa: छिन्नस्य यदि वृक्षस्य न मूलं प्रतिरोहति। बीजान्यस्य प्रवर्तन्ते मृतः क्व पुनरेष्यति॥
en: The root of a tree that has been cut down docs not revive. Only the seeds put forth sprouts. Where is the person who having died regains life?

sa: तदा तमनुपश्येत यस्मिन् दृष्टे न कथ्यते। हृदयस्थोऽन्तरात्मेति ज्ञेयो ज्ञस्तात मद्विधैः। ॥
en: When persons like ourselves say that there has been a complete identification of Knower, the Known, and Knowledge, then is the Yogin said to see the Supreme Self.

sa: नामभिश्चास्तुवं देवं ततस्तुष्टोऽभवद् भवः। परशुं च ततो देवो दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चैव मे॥
en: I sang the praises of the great God by reciting his names. At this Bhava became pleased with me, and gave me battleaxe and many other celestial weapons.

sa: रूपं चक्षुर्विपाश्च त्रिविधं ज्योतिरुच्यते। प्रेयं घ्राणं शरीरं च एते भूमिगुणाः स्मृताः॥
en: From, the eye, and the digestive fire in the stomach, are the properties of Light. Smell, the organ of smelling, and the body, are the properties of Earth.

sa: एवं स गौतमस्तत्र प्रीतः पुत्रस्य भारत। कर्मणा तेन कौरव्य चिरकारितया तथा॥
en: Thus, O Bharata, was Gautama pleased with his son, O you of Kuru's race or that act of delay on the latter's part in satisfying the former's order.

sa: गतानृषींस्तथा देवानसुरांश्च तथा गतान्। लोकादस्मात् परं लोकं यः पश्यति स मुच्यते॥
en: That man who knows that the very Rishis, the gods, and the Asuras are beings that have to depart form their respective spheres to other regions, is liberated.

sa: अतिथिः पूजितो यस्य गृहस्थस्य तु गच्छति। नान्यस्तस्मात् परो धर्म इति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The learned say that to the householders, there is no higher merit than what comes from a guest leaving his house after having been duly honoured by him.

sa: कस्यैष को नु खल्वेष किं न स्वपिति भोगवान्॥ इत्युच्चारितवाक्यौ तौ बोधयामासतुर्हरिम्।
en: Whose is he? Who is he? Why is he thus asleep on the hood of a snake? Saying these words, the two Danavas awakened Hari from his Yoga-sleep.

sa: आवामपि च धर्मस्य गृहे जातौ द्विजोत्तम। रम्यां विशालामाश्रित्य तप उग्रं समास्थितौ॥
en: We two, O foremost to twice-born ones, have taken birth in the house of Dharma. Living in this charming and spacious herinitage, we are practising the austerest penances.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि च कर्ता च विचेतव्यानि भागशः। तमः सत्त्वं रजश्चैव तेऽपि भावास्तदाश्रयाः॥
en: The senses and the Actor should be determined by apprehension of their respective functions. The states called Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas, depend upon the senses for their formation.

sa: यस्मिन् यस्मिनश्च विषये यो यो याति विनिश्चयम्। स तमेवाभिजानाति नान्यं भरतसत्तम॥
en: Whoever adopts a class of duties with steady and firm faith, praises the duties adopted by him to the exclusion of the rest, О chief of Bharata's race.

sa: यत्र संलोडिता लुब्धैः प्रायशो धर्मसेतवः। प्रदीप्तमिव चैलान्तं कस्तं देशं न संत्यजेत्॥
en: Who is there that will not leave that place, like a garment whose end has caught fire, where covetous men tries to break down the limits of virtue?

sa: तेन त्वां मर्षये शक्र दुर्मर्षणतरस्त्वया। तं मां परिणते काले परीतं कालवह्निना॥
en: It is therefore, O Shakra, that I put up with all this insolence of yours. Know, however, that I am less able to bear insolence than even you.

sa: सम्पूर्णे नवमे मासि जन्तोर्जातस्य मैथिल। जायते नामरूपत्वं स्त्री पुमान् वेति लिङ्गतः॥
en: When the ninth months is gone, O king of Mithila, the creature takes its birth so that, its sex being known, it is called a boy or girl.

sa: यस्तु कर्तारमात्मानं मन्यते साध्वसाधु वा। तस्य दोषवती प्रज्ञा अतत्त्वज्ञेति मे मतिः॥
en: He who regards himself as the doer of good or bad acts possesses a vile wisdom. Such a person is, in my opinion, does not know the truth.

sa: भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रास्थितो गन्धमादनम्। तस्य चोत्तरतो देशे दृष्टं मे दैवतं महत्॥
en: He said ordered by you I proceeded to the mountains of Gandhamadana. In the quarter lying to the north of those mountains I saw a very superior goddess,

sa: यज्वा च दान्तो मेधावी ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यसङ्गरः। न चावमन्ता दाता च वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः॥
en: He celebrated sacrifices, and was selfcontrolled and intelligent, devoted to Brahmanas and Truth. He never humiliated others, and was charitable, and wellread in the Vedas and the Vedanta.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मण्यं यदि दुष्प्राप्यं त्रिभिर्वर्णैर्नराधिप। कथं प्राप्तं महाराज क्षत्रियेण महात्मना॥ विश्वामित्रेण धर्मात्पन् ब्राह्मणत्वं नरर्षभ। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said If, O prince, it is so very difficult for the other three castes to acquire Brahmanahood, how then did the great Vishvasmitra, O king, though a Kshatriya, acquire the status of a Brahmana? I desire to know this, O sire! Therefore, do you truly describe this matter to me.

sa: तथा वे दिवसं चापि गत्वा सायं पुनर्नृप। उपावर्तन्त तत्रैव निवासार्थं शकुन्तकाः॥
en: Sometime after, the young birds going away in the morning spent the whole day out of his sight but returned in the evening for living in the nest.

sa: जम्बुक उवाच इमं कनकवर्णाभं भूषणैः समलंकृतम्। गृध्रवाक्यात् कथं पुत्रं त्यजध्वं पितृपिण्डदम्॥
en: Why, indeed, do you leave, at the vulture's suggestion, this child bearing golden hue, adorned with ornaments, and capable of giving the obsequial cake to his departed manes?

sa: स्वयं कृत्वा तु यः पापं शुभमेवानुतिष्ठति। प्रायश्चित्तं नरः कर्तुमुभयं सोऽश्नुते पृथक्॥
en: That man who, having knowingly perpetrated a sin, acts righteously for expiating that sin, has to enjoy and endure the fruits of his good and bad deeds separately.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सत्यं धर्मं प्रशंसन्ति विप्रर्षिपितृदेवताः। सत्यमिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Brahmanas, Rishis, Pitris and the gods all speak highly of the duty of truth. I wish to hear of truth. Describe it to me, O grandfather.

sa: सुलभा त्वस्य धर्मेषु मुत्तो नेति ससंशया। सत्त्वं सत्त्वेन योगज्ञा प्रविवेश महीपतेः॥
en: Doubting whether Janaka has succeeded in acquiring Liberation by following the religion of Renunciation, Sulabha, gifted with Yogapower, entered the understanding of the king by her own understanding.

sa: दूरगं बहुधागामि प्रार्थनासंशयात्मकम्। मनः सुनियतं यस्य स सुखी प्रेत्य चेह च॥
en: That person whose mind is far-reaching, capable of going on all directions, not confident about acquiring the objects it desires, and well-controlled, is happy both here and hereafter.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु पार्थ यथावृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम्। गृध्रजम्बुकसंवादं यो वृत्तो नैमिषे पुरा॥
en: 'Listen, O king, to the discourse between a vulture and a jackal as it took place in days of yore. This incident happened in the forest of Naimisha.

sa: भविष्यथ विश क्षिप्रं द्रष्टासि पितरं क्षये। अनुज्ञातो भगवता गृहं गत्वा युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Having got the permission of the illustrious god, I then went home, O Yudhishthira, and saw my father, O son, coming out after having finished his daily sacrifice.

sa: विरूप उवाच दीयमानं यदि मया नेषिष्यसि कथञ्चन। नियंस्यति त्वां नृपतिरयं धर्मानुशासकः॥
en: Virupa said If you refuge to take when I am ready to give, this king will, forsooth, punish you, for he is an upholder of justice. Vikrita said,

sa: श्यामाकमशनं तत्र सूर्यपर्णी सुवर्चला। तिक्तं च विरसं शाकं तपसा स्वादुतां गतम्॥
en: He had Shyamaka for his food, as also Suryaparni and Suvarchala and other kinds of potherbs that were bitter and distasteful. for his penances, all these tasted sweet.

sa: इयं हि मां सदा देवी भारार्ता समचोदयत्। संहारार्थं महादेव भारेणाप्सु निमज्जति॥
en: The godess Earth, suffering from the load of creatures, requested me, O Mahadeva, for destroying them, especially as she appeared to sink under their load into the water.

sa: पञ्चविंशात् परं तत्त्वं पठ्यते न नराधिप। सांख्यानां तु परं तत्त्वं यथावदनुवर्णितम्॥
en: In the Sankhya System no topic or principle above the twenty-fifth is admitted. That which the Sankhyas consider as their highest principle has been duly described (by me).

sa: नवनीतं यथा दनः काष्ठादग्निर्यथैव च। तथैव विदुषां ज्ञानं पुत्र हेतोः समुद्धृतम्॥
en: As butter from curds and fire from wood, so this has been raised for the sake of my son,-this which forms the knowledge of all truly wise men.

sa: पृथिव्यां यानि रत्नानि गुणवन्ति गुणान्विते। तान्याप्नुहि त्वं कल्याणि सुखिनी शरदां शतम्॥
en: O accomplished girl, what gems of great qualities are in the world, let them all belong to you. O blessed girl, be happy for (full) one hundred years.

sa: काममेतद्भवत्वेवं हृदयं मे त्वयि स्थितम्। भावश्चाप्यधिकं तुभ्यं देहो मित्रस्य तु प्रभो॥
en: Do what you have said. Now my body is under the possession of Mitra but my mind is attached to your and you are equally attached to me.

sa: कुत्युवाच एवमेतद् यथा प्राह धर्मचारी युधिष्ठिर। अनृतान्मे भयं तीव्र मुच्येऽहमनृतात् कथम्॥
en: Kunti said: It is so as the virtuous Yudhishthira has said. I am in great fear lest my words become untrue. How shall I be saved from untruth?

sa: ततो मही प्रविचलिता सकानना महाद्रिपाताभिहता समन्ततः। परस्परं भृशमभिवर्जतां मुहू रणाजिरे भृशमभिसंप्रवर्तिते॥
en: And when thousands of warriors continually shouted on the field of battle and mountains, with forests thereon, fell all around, the earth with her forests began to tremble.

sa: गङ्गोवाच एवमेतत् करिष्यामि पुत्रस्तस्य विधीयताम्। नास्य मोघः संगमः स्यात् पुत्रहेतोर्मया सह॥
en: Ganga said : I shall do as you desire. But so that my companionship with him may not be entirely fruitless, do this that one son may live.

sa: निखातं यच्च वै वित्तं केनचिद् भृगुवेश्मनि। वैरायैव तदा न्यस्तं क्षत्रियान् कोपयिष्णुभिः॥
en: The wealth that the Bhrigus have kept hidden under the earth had been placed there with the object of enraging the Kshatriyas and creating a quarrel with them.

sa: मातुर्नियोगाद्धर्मात्मा गाङ्गेयस्य च धीमतः। क्षेत्रे विचित्रवीर्यस्य कृष्णद्वैपायन: पुरा॥ त्रीनग्नीनिवकौरव्याञ्जनयामास वीर्यवान्। उत्पाद्य धृतराष्ट्रं च पाण्डु विदुरमेव च॥ जगाम तपसे धीमान्पुनरेवाश्रमं प्रति।
en: Requested by his own mother and the son of Ganga, Bhishma, the mighty and holy Krishna Dvaipayana became the father of three sons, who were like three fires, by the two wives of Vichitravirya. Having thus begotten Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura, he returned to his hermitage to prosecute this religious studies.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च भवान्प्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान्। तेषां चरितमिच्छामि कथ्यमानं त्वया द्विजः॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, you saw with your own eyes the great deeds of the Kurus and the Pandavas. I desire to hear them narrated by you.

sa: सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम्। ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः॥
en: The celestials informed me that you went coming having slain the Sūdra ascetic. You have observed piety and have given back life to dead child of the Brahmana.

sa: ततो गते भगवति कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने। यं लब्ध्वा सुविपुलं राज्ञां दत्त्वाभयं तदा॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having acquired that great victory and having also dispelled the fears of the kings, when the illustrious Krishna, the son of Devaki went away,

sa: जानता वै परं धर्मं वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। अगम्यागमनं कस्मात् कृतं तेन महर्षिणा॥
en: Why did that great and illustrious Rishi Vasishtha, knowing as he knew all the great precepts of religion, went to a woman to whom he should not go?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरस्तं तथेत्युक्त्वा भीष्मेण सह भारत। पाण्डु संस्कारयामास देशे परमपूजिते॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of the Bharata race, Vidura said, “Be it so" and he with Bhishma performed the funeral ceremony of Pandu on a sacred spot.

sa: ते न तस्य प्रत्यगृह्णन् यदुप्रभृतयो जराम्। तमब्रवीत् ततः पूरुः कनीयान् सत्यविक्रमः॥ राजश्चराभिनवया तन्वा यौवनगोचरः। अहं जरां समादाय राज्ये स्थास्यामि तेऽऽज्ञया॥
en: Yadu and other sons did not agree to take upon them his old age. Thereupon, his youngest son, the virtuous and powerful Puru said-"O king, enjoy again with a renovated body and returned youth. I shall take upon me your old age and I shall rule the kingdom at your command."

sa: तस्य मां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भगिनीं विद्धि भाविनी। भ्रात्रा सम्प्रेषितामार्ये त्वां सपुत्रां जिघांसता॥
en: O amiable lady, know me as being the sister of the Rakshasas chief. O respected madarn, I was sent by my brother to kill you with your sons.

sa: दुष्टेन मनसा यो वै प्रच्छन्नेनान्तरात्मना। ब्रूयान्निःश्रेयसं नाम कथं कुर्यात् सतां मतम्॥
en: How can the wise accept the advice which is pronounced good by the man who speaks with wicked intention, taking care to conceal the wickedness of his heart?

sa: शम एव परो धर्मस्तमाचर पराशर। अधर्मिष्ठं वरिष्ठः सन् कुरुषे त्वं पराशर॥
en: O Parashara, peace is the highest virtue; therefore practice peace. O Parashara, being such a superior man, you (should not) consider sinful acts to be for your good.

sa: ततः स बुबुधे पश्चात् तमृषि नृपसत्तमः। ऋषे पुत्रं वसिष्ठस्य वसिष्ठमिव तेजसा॥
en: Thereupon after the curse on the excellent king (had been uttered) he came to know that the Rishi was the son of Vasishtha as powerful as Vasishtha himself.

sa: तथा पितृन् वैतरणी दुस्तरा पापकर्मभिः। गङ्गा भवति वै प्राप्य कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥ असम्बाधा देवनदी स्वर्गसम्पादनी शुभा। कथमिच्छसि तां रोर्बु नैष धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: And in the region of Pitris, it is called Vaitarani, which is not crossable by the sinners, Krishna Dvaipayana has said that this auspicious and celestials river is accessible at all times by all. Why do you wish to bar us from it? It is not consonant with the eternal virtue.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु गोवासनस्य शैव्यस्य देविकां नाम कन्यां स्वयंवरे लेभे। तस्यां पुत्रं जनयामास यौधेयं नाम॥ भीमसेनोऽपि काश्यां बलन्धरां नामोपयेमे वीर्यशुल्काम्। तस्यां पुत्रं सर्वगं नामोत्यादयामास॥
en: Yudhishthira obtained in Svayamvara for his wife Devika, the daughter of Govasana of the Shaivya race and he begot on her a son, named Yaudheya. Bhima also obtained for his wife Balandhara, the daughter of the king of Kashi, by offering as his dower his own great prowess. He begot on her a son, named Sarvaga.

sa: चैत्यकस्य गिरेः शृङ्गं भित्त्वा किमिह छद्मना। अद्वारेण प्रविष्टाः स्थ निर्भया राजकिल्बिषात्॥
en: Breaking down the peak of the Chaityaka hill, why in disguise have you entered (the city) by the other ways than the gates without fearing the royal anger?

sa: ब्रह्मचर्यं परो धर्मः स चापि नियतस्त्वयि। यस्मात् तस्मादहं पार्थ रणेऽस्मि विजितस्त्वया॥
en: Brahmacharya is a great virtue, you are in it (leAding that mode of life). O Partha it is for this that I was defeated by you in battle.

sa: तद्वत्से ब्रूहि वत्सं स्वं कुमारं वृद्धसंमतम्। ममाद्य त्वं सभृत्यस्य मोक्षार्थं वेदवित्तमम्॥
en: Therefore, O sister, ask your dear son, who is exceedingly learned in the Vedas and respected even by the old, to protect me and those dependent on me.

sa: तस्मिन् कर्मणि संसिद्धे पर्यष्वजत पाण्डवम्। मेने च दुपदं संख्ये सानुबन्धं पराजितम्॥
en: As soon as this feat was performed, he (Drona) embraced the son of Pandu (Arjuna) and thought that Drupada with his friends were already vanquished in the battle.

sa: असामान्यमिदं तात लोकेष्वस्त्रं निगद्यते। तद् धारयेथाः प्रयतः शृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: O son, it is said that this weapon heat not a superior in the three worlds, keep it therefore with great care and listen to what I say.

sa: एषां चान्यतमत्यागो नृशंसो गर्हितो बुधैः। आत्मत्यागे कृते चेमे मरिष्यन्ति मया विना॥
en: To abandon any of these (my wife son or daughter) will be a cruel and most wicked act. If I sacrifice myself, they will (also) die without me.

sa: कथं हि विधवानाथा बालुपत्रा विना त्वया। मिथुनं जीवयिष्यामि स्थिता साधुगते पथि॥
en: Being a helpless widow with two children of tender years depending on me how shall I be able to live leading my life in the path of virtue.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि हयमेधेन भक्त्या च द्विजसत्तमाः।।१७। अस्य बाल्हिपतेश्चैव किं करोमि प्रियं शुभम्।
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, I have been greatly delighted with this sacrifice and your devotion. Tell me now, what I can do for this king of Valhika.

sa: स राजा सह पत्न्या वै प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः। पुनर्वसिष्ठं प्रोवाच यदुक्तं ब्रह्मरूपिणा॥
en: Thereupon the king with his spouse again and again bowed to Vasistha's feet and informed him of what the Rākşasa had done under the guise of a Brāhmana.

sa: उलूप्युवाच जानाम्यहं पाण्डवेय यथा चरसि भेदिनीम्। यथा च ते ब्रह्मचर्यमिदमादिष्टवान् गुरुः॥
en: Ulupi said : O son of Pandu, I know why you are roaming over the world and why you observe Brahmacharya at the command of your elder (brother).

sa: वासुकेः सर्पराजस्य जरत्कारुः स्वसा किल। स तस्यां भविता पुत्रः शापान्नागांश्च मोक्ष्यति॥
en: Vasuki, the king of the snakes, has a sister, named Jaratkaru: the son I speak of will be born in her womb and he will save the snakes.

sa: तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वाल्मीकिरिदमब्रवीत्। सीतेयं समनुप्राप्ता पत्नी रामस्य धीमतः॥ स्नुषा दशरथस्यैषा जनकस्य सुता सती। अपापा पतिना त्यक्ता परिपाल्या मया सदा॥
en: Hearing their words the great Vālmīki replied in worthy accents-"This Sītā is the wife of the intelligent Rāma, the daughter-in-law of Daśaratha and the daughter of Janaka. She has now come to our hermitage. She is chaste and innocent, still her husband has renounced her. So we should all protect her.

sa: एवं समुदिते लोके मानुषे भरतर्षभ। असुरा जज्ञिरे क्षेत्रे राज्ञां तु मनुजेश्वर॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O lord of men, when such was the happy state of the world, the Asuras began to take birth in royal dynasties.

sa: रत्नैः प्रलोभयामासुः स्त्रीभिश्चोभौ पुनः पुनः। न च तौ चक्रतुर्भङ्गं व्रतस्य सुमहाव्रतौ॥
en: They again and again tempted them with gems and jewels and the most handsome maidens. But those two (brothers), firmly engaged in asceticism, did not break their VOWS,

sa: अष्टक उवाच कस्यैते प्रतिदृश्यन्ते रथाः पञ्च हिरण्मयाः। यानारुह्य नरो लोकानभिवाञ्छति शाश्वतान्॥
en: Ashtaka said : To whom does these fine cars belong that we see before us? Do men ride on them who go to the regions of everlasting bliss?

sa: एषा मया सम्पतता वारुणी भरतर्षभ। दृष्टपूर्वा सभा रम्या कुबेरस्य सभां शृणु॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, such is the charming assembly-hall of Varuna that I saw before in my travel. Here now about the assembly-hall of Kubera. sons

sa: गतिं चैव न पश्यामि तस्मान्मोक्षाय रक्षसः। सोऽहं दुःखार्णवे मग्नो महत्यसुकरे भृशम्॥
en: I do not see any means to save myself from the Rakshasas; therefore, I am plunged into a great ocean of grief, from which there is no escape.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सम्राङ्गणमभीप्सन् वै युष्मान् स्वार्थपरायणः। कथं प्रहिणुयां कृष्ण सोऽहं केवलसाहसात्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Krishna, depending only on courage, how can I send you (to Jarasandha) out of selfish motives and out of the desire of the imperial dignity?

sa: कुर्यान्न निन्दितं कर्म न नृशंसं कथंचन। इति पूर्वे महात्मान आपद्धर्मविदो विदुः॥ श्रेयांस्तु सहदारस्य विनाशोऽद्य मम स्वयम्। ब्राह्मणस्य वधं नाहमनुमंस्ये कदाचन॥
en: The high-souled men, learned in the precepts that should be adopted in distress and danger, formerly said that one should never perform a cruel and censurable act. It is best for me that I should myself perish to day with my wife. I shall never cause the death of a Brahmana.

sa: यच्चक्षुषा द्रष्टुमिच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन। तत् पश्येद् यादृशं चेच्छेत् तादृशं द्रष्टुमर्हति॥
en: Whatever you will desire to see by your eyes in this world and whatever its nature it will be seen by you (by the help of this science).

sa: ते क्षत्रिया रङ्गगताः समेता जिगीपमाणा दुपदात्मजां ताम्। मुमां यथा देवगणाः समेताः॥
en: Those Kshatriyas, assembled in that arena, each eagerly desiring to win the daughter of Drupada, appeared like the celestials standing round Uma, the daughter of the Mountain king.

sa: कथमेका बहूनां स्याद् धर्मपत्नी न संकरः। एतन्मे भगवान् सर्वं प्रब्रवीतु यथातथम्॥
en: Drupada said : O illustrious one, how can one women become the wife of many men without being defiled by sin. Tell me truly all this in detail.

sa: तस्य तस्य प्रसादात्त्वं देवि पुत्राञ्जनिष्यसि। एवमुक्ता च सा बाला तदा कौतूहलान्विता॥
en: (They will instantly come) and by their grace you will give birth to offspring." Thus addressed that girl, being much curious (to see the effect of the Mantra).

sa: राजर्षीणां च तं श्रुत्वा महिमानं महात्मनाम्। यज्वनां कर्मभिः पुण्यैर्लोकप्राप्ति समीक्ष्य च॥ हरिश्चन्द्रं च राजर्षि रोचमानं विशेषतः। यज्वानं यज्ञमाहर्तुं राजसूयमियेष सः॥
en: Having heard the glory of the illustrious kings of old and having known their acquisition of regions of felicity by the performance of sacrifices and scared deeds, and having also thought the great sacrifice performed by the royal sage Harishchandra, the king Yudhishthira desired to make preparations for the Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: एवं दत्तास्मि रामाय तथा तस्मिन् स्वयंवरे। अनुरक्तास्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम्॥
en: Thus was I bestowed on Rāma on the occasion of that self-choice. And ever since I have been devoted to my husband, the foremost of those possessing prowess.

sa: भक्ताश्चैवानुरक्ताश्च हिताश्च मम नित्यशः। हन्यमाना न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युर्वचो मम॥
en: Bearing regard and attached to me, and ever engaged in my welfare, they, assailed by others, are incapable of being slain; nor do they not obey my orders.

sa: निष्कुटश्चैव देशोऽयं वञ्चिताश्चापि ते वयम्। निवेदयाम ते सर्वं स्वके दाशगृहे वस॥
en: This place is your home. But you have stolen a march over us. We dedicate all this to you. Do you reside in the abode of your servant.

sa: प्रयाते तु महारण्यं चिररात्राय राघवे। बभूव नगरे मूर्छा बलमूर्छा जनस्य च॥
en: On Rāghava having left for the forest to stay there for a long period, the men and beasts within the city were deprived of their senses (by grief).

sa: आर्ये कस्मादजानन्तं गर्हसे मामकल्मषम्। विपुलां च मम प्रीति स्थितां जानासि राघवे॥
en: O noble lady, what for do you censure me who am without sin and who know nothing of this? You know that profuse is my delight in Rāghava.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी पुत्रं व्यजायत। मारीचं नाम दुर्धर्षं यः शापाद् राक्षसोऽभवत्॥
en: After a length of time, that Yakṣī gave birth to a son, named Mārīca, possessed of irrepressible energy, him who became a Rākṣasa in consequence of a curse.

sa: न च ते विषये कश्चिद् ब्राह्मणो वस्तुमर्हति। तादृशं त्वममर्यादमद्य कर्म करिष्यसि॥
en: No Brāhmaṇa will dwell in your dominion, such is the ungracious deed you are going to do. [Surely we will go the way that is wended by Rama.

sa: अक्षय्यं मधुहन्तारं जानामि त्वां सुरेश्वरम्। धनुषोऽस्य परामर्शात् स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु परंतप ॥
en: Even from your handing of this bow I know you to be the chief of the celestials even that eternal one, the slayer of Madhu. Hail to you,

sa: स्तुवन्तं तं तदा सूतं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम्॥ प्रतिबुद्ध्य ततो राजा इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: Perceiving from the voice that it was charioteer Sumantra versed in good counsels, who was thus eulogising, the king rose up from his bed and thus addressed him:

sa: विषादात्विह मां दृष्ट्वा पौरैर्मन्त्रिभिरेव च॥ अभिषिक्तो न कामेन तन्मे क्षन्तुं त्वमर्हसि।
en: Seeing me enter in a dejected mood, the citizens and counsellors installed me, but it was not done with my will. Therefore it behoves you to forgive me.

sa: कच्चित्ते सम्भृता भृत्याः कच्चित् तिष्ठन्ति शासने। कच्चित्ते विजिताः सर्वे रिपवो रिपुसूदन॥
en: O virtuous one, are your retainers maintained on salaries from the kingdom? Do they abode by your mandates? And, O destroyer of foes, hast you vanquished your enemies?

sa: परिश्रान्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा जरया पक्षियूथपम्। उत्पपात पुनर्हष्टो मैथिली गृह्य रावणः॥
en: Thereupon, finding the lord of birds worn out on account of his old age, Ravana, highly encouraged, again rose high up in the welkin, taking Maithill with him.

sa: यस्यास्तव पतिस्त्यक्तो राजा दशरथः स्वयम्। भर्ता सर्वस्य जगतः स्थावरस्य चरस्य च॥ नाकार्यतमं किंचित्तव देवीह विद्यते। पतिघ्नीं त्वामहं मन्ये कुलघ्नीमपि चान्ततः॥
en: O worshipful one, since you have forsaken king Dasaratha, the maintainer of this world and the mobile and the immobile that it contains, there is nothing that is incapable of being done by you. I consider you the murderess of your husband and as one that has finally exterminated one's line.

sa: अनिष्टे सुभगाकारे सौभाग्येन विकत्थसे। चलं हि तव सौभाग्यं नद्याः स्रोत इवोष्णगे॥
en: You boast of good fortune while misfortune is yours in the shape of luck. Your good fortune is surely unstable like the tide of a river during summer.

sa: न देवि बत दुःखेन स्वर्गमप्यभिरोचये। नहि मेऽस्ति भयं किंचित् स्वयम्भोरिव सर्वतः॥
en: I do not long for, Oh worshipful one, even the abode of celestials gained through your affliction; fear there is none for me like to the self-create Brahma.

sa: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतिः। तत्र चैका महाभागा भार्गवं देववर्चसम्॥ ववन्दे पद्मपत्राक्षी काङ्गिणी पुत्रमुत्तमम्। एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै गरलं ददौ॥
en: It is said that at the time, his two wives were gone with child. There one of the exalted ladies having eyes resembling lotus petals saluted Bhrgu's son furnished with the splendour of a celestial, desirous of having an excellent son. Another administered poison to the other for destroying her foetus.

sa: न मे तथा पार्थिव दीयते मनो महत्सु कामेषु न चात्मनः प्रिये। यथा निदेशे तव शिष्टसम्मते व्यपैतु दु:खं तव मत्कृतेऽनघ ॥
en: You confer I do not, O king, set my heart upon any great object of desire, nor do I seek my own behoof, as I am bent upon, O you beloved of the good, working out your will. O sinless one, you will not therefore reap any evil on my account.

sa: सक्तं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु कामवृत्तं महीपतिम्। लुब्धं न बहु मन्यन्ते श्मशानाग्निमिव प्रजाः॥
en: The subjects do not esteem a monarch that is given to sensual enjoyments, in intent upon satisfying his lust and is covetous like the fire in a cemetery.

sa: पौरा ह्यात्मकृताद् दुःखाद् विप्रमोच्या नृपात्मजैः। न तु खल्वात्मना योज्या दुःखेन पुरवासिनः॥
en: A prince should deliver citizens from the calamity they bring upon themselves; but he should by no means drag them into those which he himself has brought on.

sa: अस्मिन् कार्ये विनिर्वृत्ते कृते दाशरथे: प्रिये। ऋणान्मुक्ता भविष्यामः कृतार्थार्थविदां वर ॥
en: Having performed this task satisfactorily, and brought about what is dear to Dasaratha's son, we shall, O best of those that achieve success, be freed from our debts.

sa: तस्यायमाश्रमः पुण्यस्तस्येमे मुनयः पुरा। शिष्या धर्मपरा वीर तेषां पापं न विद्यते॥
en: This sacred hermitage belongs to Śiva; and these ascetics engaged in pious acts, O hero, have been from father to son his disciples. And no sin touch them.

sa: ततस्त्वां प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्ताकुलं मनः। त्वद्वृत्तं चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेनिःश्रेयसं हितम्॥
en: Seeing you set out, my mind reflecting on your truthfulness as well as your happiness in this world and welfare in the next, is wrought up with anxiety.

sa: नास्ति धन्यतरो राम त्वत्तोऽन्यो भुवि कश्चन। गोप्ता कुशिकपुत्रस्ते येन तप्तं महत्तपः॥
en: O Rāma, there exist of this earth not one that is more fortunate than thyself. Your protector is even Kusika's descendant, by whom mighty austerities have been performed.

sa: यदेवं विहिते कार्ये यद्धितं पुरुषर्षभ। तत् तद् ब्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठ त्वर कालव्यतिक्रमः।॥
en: O you best of men, do you speedily relate to him all those benefits which we shall reap by his actions, for the proper season is well-nigh past.

sa: अनृतं वत लोकोऽयमज्ञानाद् यदि वक्ष्यति। तेजो नास्ति परं रामे तपतीव दिवाकरे॥
en: Henceforth, if people through ignorance say that the sun has not that burning flood of light which in Rāma does shine forth, woe is them, it is falsehood.

sa: अनङ्ग इति विख्यातस्तदाप्रभृति राघव। स चाङ्गविषयः श्रीमान् यत्राङ्ग स मुमोच ह॥
en: O Rāghava, from that time forth, he has become known as Ananga. And the place where he was deprived of his body is the lovely land of Anga.

sa: स ममादर्शनाद् दीनो बाल्यात् प्रभृति लालितः। तटाक इव पीताम्बुरुपशोषं गमिष्यति ॥
en: Brought up by me from his very infancy, he shall by my separation, wear away like to a pond having its liquid contents drunk up by an elephant.

sa: एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुताः। तेषां वै समवेतानामपि कश्चिद् गयां व्रजेत्॥
en: One should wish for many sons crowned with qualities and versed in various lore, for the chance is that one at least of these may repair to Gayā.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्यात्मनश्चैव रामस्तेनाकरोज्जटाः। दीर्घबाहुर्नरव्याघ्रो जटिलत्वमधारयत्॥ तौ तदा चीरसम्पन्नौ जटामण्डलधारिणौ। अशोभेतामृषिसमौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: And that mighty-armed chief of men wore matted locks. And those brothers Rāma and Lakş maņa dressed as mendicants, and wearing heads of matted hair, appeared like saints.

sa: सुमन्त्र रामं द्रक्ष्यामि शीघ्रमानय सुन्दरम्। स मन्यमानः कल्याणं हृदयेन ननन्द च॥ निर्जगाम च स प्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात्। सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया॥
en: Sumantra, Bring the beautiful Răma here, I want to see him. Thinking that some good would accrue to Rāma, he was pleased at heart and away he went speedily delighted at the royal mandate. Being asked again by Kaikeyi to hurry on at the time of departure Sumantra thought within himself.

sa: स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बलम्। सालमेकं विनिर्भिद्य भवेद् व्यक्तिर्बलाबले॥
en: There is still doubt, O worshipful one, which of you is the mightier? Truly shall your strength be manifested in the piercing of one of these Sala trees.

sa: एको ह्यहमयोध्यां च पृथिवीं चापि लक्ष्मण । तरेयमिषुभिः क्रुद्धो ननु वीर्यमकारणम्॥
en: O Laksmana, enraged, I alone without doubt, can rid Ayodhyā, the Earth herself, by means of my arrows. But improper is the display of prowess for no reason,

sa: अङ्गराजेन सख्यं च तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति। कन्या चास्य महाभागा शान्ता नाम भविष्यति॥ पुत्रस्त्वङ्गस्य. राज्ञस्तु रोमपाद इति श्रुतः। तं स राजा दशरथो गमिष्यति महायशाः।४।। अनपत्योऽस्मि धर्मात्मन्शान्ताभर्ता मम क्रतुम्। आहरेत त्वयाऽऽज्ञप्त: संतानार्थे कुलस्य च ॥
en: That king will contract friendship with the ruler of the Angas. And the latter will have a highly pious daughter, śāntā by name. And the (old) king of the Angas will have a son, named Romapāda. And repairing to him, the highly famous king Dasaratha will speak to Romapada, O righteous-souled one! I am without issue. Let śāntā's husband, desired by you, take charge of this sacrifice of mine, to be celebrated with the object of my obtaining a son to perpetuate the race.

sa: दनुर्नाम दितेः पुत्रः शापाद् राक्षसतां गतः। आख्यातस्तेन सुग्रीवः समर्थो वानराधिपः॥ स ज्ञास्यति महावीर्यस्तव भार्यापहारिणम्। एवमुक्त्वा दनुः स्वर्ग भ्राजमानो दिवं गतः॥
en: A son of Diti named Danu, had, by virtue of an imprecation, undergone Raksasa-hood. He it is who had related to us all about the capable Sugrīva.—That exceedingly puissant one shall have a knowledge of the ravisher of your wife? Having said this, Danu beaming (with a halo) went to heaven.

sa: किं तु यावन्न यात्यस्तं सविता श्रान्तवाहनः। तावन्मामवटे क्षिप्त्वा दह राम यथाविधि॥
en: Do you cremate me according to the prescribed rites after throwing me into the ditch before the sun, with his worn out carriers descends into the western horizon.

sa: स सुखी गृध्रराजस्तु रावणेन हतो रणे। मुक्तश्च सुग्रीवभयाद् गतश्च परमां गतिम्॥
en: Happy is that king of vultures, having been slain by Rāvaņa in battle. He has got quit of the fear of Sugrīva, and has also attained supreme state.

sa: अङ्गदेन समाख्यातो ज्यास्वनेन च वानरः। बुबुधे लक्ष्मणं प्राप्तं मुखं चास्य व्यशुष्यत॥
en: Informed before by Angada of his approach, and made doubly sure by the twang of the bow, that monkey came to know of Lakşmaņa's arrival and turned pale.

sa: प्रियया च तथोक्तः सः केकयः पृथिवीपतिः। तस्मै तं वरदायार्थं कथयामास तत्त्वतः॥
en: Thus addressed by his beloved spouse, that lord of earth Kekaya went to the saint that had conferred the boon on him and related to him everything faithfully.

sa: एवं दत्तास्मि रामाय तथा तस्मिन् स्वयंवरे। अनुरक्तास्मि धर्मेण पतिं वीर्यवतां वरम्॥
en: Thus was I bestowed on Rāma on the occasion of that self-choice. And ever since I have been devoted to my husband, the foremost of those possessing prowess.

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणामिहाद्यैव कश्चिद् राजा विधीयताम्। अराजकं हि नो राष्ट्र विनाशं समवाप्नुयात् ।।८
en: Do you select some on this very day from the descendants of Ikşvāku, to be king here. Verily does a kingdom go to ruin, when without a king.

sa: गवां स्पृशतु पादेन गुरून् परिवदेत च। मित्रे दुह्येत सोऽत्यर्थं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: Or! May he that had approved the exile of the noble one to the woods touch a cow with his feet, revile his superiors, and injure his friends!

sa: अहं राघव कैकेय्या वरदानेन मोहितः। अयोध्यायां त्वमेवाद्य भव राजा निगृह्य माम्॥
en: O Rāghava, I have been deprived of my senses in consequence of my having conferred boons on Kaikeyi. Do you therefore confining me to-day become king in Ayodhyā.

sa: एष विग्रहवान् धर्म एष वीर्यवतां वरः। एष विद्याधिको लोके तपसश्च परायणम्॥
en: This one is Virtue incarnate : this one is the foremost of those possessing prowess. This one surpass all others in learning, and is the refuge of asceticism.

sa: इमे गङ्गोदकघटाः सागरेभ्यश्च काञ्चनाः। औदुम्बरं भद्रपीठमभिषेकार्थमाहृतम्॥ सर्वबीजानि गन्धाश्च रत्नानि विविधानि च। क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः॥ अष्टौ च कन्या रुचिरा मत्तश्च वरवारणः। चतुरश्वो रथः श्रीमान् निस्त्रिंशो धनुरुत्तमम्॥ वाहनं नरसंयुक्तं छत्रं च शशिसंनिभम्। श्वेते च वालव्यजने भृङ्गारं च हिरण्मयम्॥ हेमदामपिनद्धश्च ककुद्मान् पाण्डुरो वृषः। केसरी च चतुर्दष्ट्रो हरिश्रेठो महाबलः॥ सिंहासनं व्याघ्रतनुः समिधश्च हुताशनः। सर्वे वादित्रसङ्घाश्च वेश्याश्चालंकृताः स्त्रियः॥ आचार्या ब्राह्
en: Here are golden vessels filled with water from the Gangā and the ocean; and for the installation, an excellent udumbara seat, and all kinds of seeds, and scents and various gems, and honey, and curds and clarified butter and fried paddy, and milk, and sacrificial grass, flowers, and milk, and eight good-looking maids, and an excellent mad elephant, a car yoked with four horses, and a sword, and an elegant bow, and a carriage containing men, and an umbrella like to the moon, and two white cámaras, and a golden vase, and a pale-coloured bull tethered with a golden chains and bearing a hump adorned with ornaments, and a mighty lion, the best of his race, furnished with four teeth, and a throne, and a tiger-skin, and sacrificial fuel, and fire, and all kinds of musical instruments, and courtez

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले देवि सम्प्राप्तः सुमहानयम्। अनयो नयसम्पन्ने यत्र ते विकृता मतिः॥
en: And this signal lawlessness, O exalted lady, has befallen the race of the Ikşvākus, the cause of which, O You versed in moral laws, is your mental derangement.

sa: याचितेन सुरश्रेष्ठ पित्रा तव महात्मना। वरो वर्षसहस्रान्ते मम दत्तः सुतं प्रति॥
en: On your high-souled sire having been besought by me, he, O foremost of celestials, granted me the boon that after a thousand years, I shall obtain a son.

sa: निवर्तय रथं शीघ्रं दण्डकान् नय मामपि। अथ तान् नानुगच्छामि गमिष्यामि यमक्षयम्॥
en: Do you without delay turn the car. Do you take me also to Dandaka. If I do not follow them, I shall repair to the mansion of Yama.

sa: तस्याग्रमधिरूढास्ते श्रान्ता विपुलविक्रमाः। न पश्यन्तु स्म वैदेहीं रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम् ॥
en: And ascending its top*, those ones endued with immense prowess, experiencing fatigue, could not find Vaidehi, the beloved spouse of Rama. *i.e. the top of the Silvern Hill.

sa: नहि सामोपपन्नानां प्रहर्ता विद्यते भुवि।' नीचेष्वपि जनः कश्चित् किमङ्ग बत मद्विधः॥
en: Even among the mean, there is none on earth that can slay people who assume a mild attitude. What shall I say, alas! of superior ones like myself?

sa: ऋषीणां च प्रसादेन कपिवृद्धमतेन च॥ गुरूणां च प्रसादेन संप्लव त्वं महार्णवम्।
en: By the grace of the saints, and with the permission of the aged monkeys, and by the blessing of the superiors, do you bound over the mighty main.

sa: स्त्रीणामश्वमुखीनां तु निकेतस्तत्र तत्र तु। तं देशं समतिक्रम्य आश्रमं सिद्धसेवितम्॥ सिद्धा वैखानसा यत्र बालखिल्याश्च तापसाः। दतव्यास्ततः सिद्धास्तपसा वीतकल्मषाः॥ प्रष्टव्या चापि सीतायाः प्रवृत्तिर्विनयान्वितैः।
en: There are all over, the homes of females with faces resembling those of horses. Going beyond that part, (you shall come to) the asylum inhabited by Siddhas; where ascetics—Vālakhilyas, Siddhas and Vaikhānasas. Saluting those Siddhas, who have been cleansed of their sins on account of their asceticism, you should in humble guise ask them concerning Sītā.

sa: कनीयानेष मे भ्राता अहं ज्येष्ठो महामुने। ददामि परमप्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Thus one, O mighty anchorite, is my younger brother, and I am his elder. O powerful ascetic, well pleased will I confer on you these as your daughter-in-law,

sa: न कश्चिद् भगवन् किंचित् पूर्ववृत्तमिदं मयि। दृश्यते विकृतं येन विक्रियन्ते तपस्विनः॥
en: O reverend one, do you find me deviating from the path of former sovereigns, or acting contrary to their practice, which has perplexed (the minds of) these ascetics?

sa: युक्तदण्डा हि मृदवः प्रशान्ताः वसुधाधिपाः। सदा त्वं सर्वभूतानां शरण्यः परमा गतिः॥
en: Kings, gentle and mild by nature, do always administer punishment, proportionate to the amount of offence. You are always the stay and the best refuge of all animals.

sa: अर्थं वा यदि वा कामं शिष्टाः शास्त्रेष्वनागतम्। व्यवस्यन्त्यनु राजानं धर्मं पौलस्त्यनन्दन॥
en: O son of Paulastya, at the instance of the king mild subjects perform many an action conducing to virtue, wealth and desire, though not mentioned in the Šāstras.

sa: निर्गुणस्यापि पुत्रस्य कथं स्याद् विनिवासनम्। किं पुनर्यस्य लोकोऽयं जितो वृत्तेन केवलम्॥
en: Who ever exiles his son, albeit he be worthless? And what is to be said concerning a son that has fast secured all men's hearts by his behaviour?

sa: वत्स्यामि मानुषे लोके पालयन् पृथिवीमिमाम्। एवं दत्त्वा वरं देवो देवानां विष्णुरात्मवान्॥
en: Having thus conferred a boon upon the gods, the lord Vişnu of subdued soul fell to thinking as to the place where he would be born among men.
