sa: न तेष्वहःसु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वा न दृश्यते। नाविद्वान् ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन्नाशतानुचरस्तथा॥
en: And on that day no Brāhmaṇa ever felt tired, or hungry and there was none that was not learned, or that was not followed by an hundred persons.

sa: सुग्रीव दोषेण न मां गन्तुमर्हसि किल्वषात्। कृष्यमाणं भविष्येण बुद्धिमोहेन मां बलात्॥
en: O Sugrīva, do you not take to your heart the improper conduct I have shown towards you, being attracted by inevitable foolishness, subject as I was to sin.

sa: रामस्यैव हितायैष याति दाशरथेः कपिः। सत्क्रियां कुर्वता शक्त्या तोषितोऽस्मि दृढं त्वया।१३४
en: This monkey, is going in the interests of Rāma, Dasaratha's son—and you had welcomed him to the best of your mighty. Therefore I am greatly pleased with you.

sa: समर्थो नास्मि ते दातुं युद्धं युद्धविशारद। श्रूयतां त्वभिधास्यामि यस्ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति॥
en: O you that are skilled in fight, I am not competent to offer you fight; but lister to me who will tell you who shall offer the fight.

sa: अथवाऽऽदाय रक्षांसि न्यसेयुः संवृते हि माम्। यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवः॥
en: Or the Rākşasas taking me away shall keep me in such a secret place, that neither the monkeys nor Rāghava shall be able to ascertain my where abouts.

sa: अब्रवीच्च दशग्रीवः समीपस्थं महोदरम्। उपस्थापय मे शीघ्रं चारानिति निशाचरः।। महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तु शीघ्रमात्रापयच्चरान्॥
en: Then that ranger of night, the Ten-necked one, said to Mahodara, who was present, to summon some spies. Thus accosted, Mahodara speedily ordered some spies (to present themselves).

sa: ततः शरैर्भिन्नभुजान्तरः कपिः कुमारवर्येण महात्मना नदन्। महाभुजः कर्मविशेषतत्त्वविद् विचिन्तयामास रणे पराक्रमम्॥
en: Wounded in the arm with shafts by that highsouled, noble prince, that mighty-armed one, capable of adequately appreciating the nature of actions, thought on (Aksa's) prowess in battle.

sa: ततो हि दुर्मना रामः श्रुत्वैव वदतां गिरः। दध्यौ मुहूर्त धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः॥
en: Hearing the lamentations (of the Rākşasas and monkeys) the virtuous-souled Rāma, with a poor heart and having his eyes full of tears, engaged in meditation for some time.

sa: तन्नियोगे नियुक्तेन कृतं कृत्यं हनूमता। न चात्मा लघुतां नीतः सुग्रीवश्चापि तोषितः॥
en: Anent the order (which he had received), Hanuman has done the work (and more). He has not been humbled,* and, further, he has pleased Sugriva. *By the Raksasas.

sa: अस्मिन् विनष्टे नहि भूतमन्यं पश्यामि यस्तौ नरराजपुत्रौ। वुद्योजयेद् वै भवता विरुद्धौ॥
en: On his being killed, another see I not who, O you that love warfare, can move those haughty sons of a king to take up arms against you.

sa: कोऽयं कस्य कुतो वापि किंकार्यं कोऽभ्युपाश्रयः। इति राक्षसवीराणां दृष्ट्वा संजज्ञिरे कथाः॥
en: “Who is he? And whose son? And where from? And what's his errand? And by whom is he backed?” Thus did the heroic Rākşasas converse on beholding Hanumān.

sa: तत्प्रापयन्तं वचनं तूणमाप्लुत्य वानराः॥ प्रापद्यन्तः तदा क्षिप्रं लोप्नुं हन्तुं च मुष्टिभिः।
en: Hearing him speak thus, the monkeys leaped up quickly and reached there with a view to chop off his wings or to slay him with their clenched fists.

sa: अथ तामब्रवीत् वीरो हनुमानग्रतः स्थिताम्। कथयिष्यामि तत् तत्त्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसे॥ का त्वं विरूपनयना पुरद्वारेऽवतिष्ठसे। किमर्थं चापि मां क्रोधान्निर्भर्त्सयसि दारुणे॥
en: Thereat, the heroic Hanumān spoke to her staying in front of him, “I shall tell you all about that anent which you questionest me. Who are you that having deformed eyes stayest at the gate of this city? And what for, O frightful one, do you rail at me in wrath?"

sa: ततः स किंकरान्हत्वा हनूमान् ध्यानमास्थितः। वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रासादो न विनाशितः॥
en: Having slaughtered the servants, Hanumān, having reflected awhile, thought, “I have broken down the wood; but have not destroyed the edifice dedicated to the deities of the Rākşasas.”

sa: नीलजीमूतसंकाशस्तप्तकाश्चनकुण्डलः॥ राक्षसेन्द्रः स तु तदा चिन्तयत्सुमहामतिः। अथाब्रवीत्सुतां रक्षः कैकसी नाम नामतः॥
en: And that great-minded lord of Rākşasas, resembling dark clouds, decked in burnished earrings of gold, then began to reflect. And then the Raksasa addressed his daughter, named Kaikasi.

sa: न त्वस्यब्रुवतो जातु लक्ष्यते दुष्टभावता। प्रसन्न वदनं चापि तस्मान्मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: I did not however mark anything of his wickedness while he spoke; rather I did observe signs of gladness on his countenance. So I do not suspect him.

sa: एष ह्यतिबलः सैन्ये रथेन पवनौजसा। गमिष्यति प्रवृद्धोर्मिः समुद्र इव पर्वणि ॥
en: Ascending his car, gifted with the velocity of the wind, the highly powerful one is proceeding among the army like to the deep with waves rising during Parva.

sa: विशुद्धा त्रिषु लोकेषु मैथिली जनकात्मजा। न विहातुं मया शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा॥
en: Maithili-the daughter of Janaka has been purified before the three worlds-So I am incapable of renouncing her as a self controlled person cannot forsake his (own ) reputation.

sa: यदि नामात्र शक्यं स्यात्साम्ना दानेन वानघ। तरसा वा महाबाहो प्रत्यानेतुं कृतं भवेत्॥ त्वं च लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः। त्वया राक्षसवंशोऽयं निमग्नोऽपि समुद्धृतः॥
en: O mighty-armed one, if you can through selfcontrol or charity or by a sudden display of prowess, repossesses yourself of the same, a (great) thing shall have been achieved; and then, O child, you should, without doubt, be the lord of Lankā; and this Raksasa race, which has sunk, shall have been raised up by you.

sa: त्वयि प्रवजिते वीर गुरोश्च वचने स्थिते। रक्षसापहता भार्या प्राणैः प्रियतरा तव॥
en: O hero, you having abode by the words of your superior and having come (to the forest), your wife dearer then life itself has been ravished by Rākṣasas.

sa: महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भिः सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः। रराज वीरैश्च विनिःशवसभ्दिर्ह्लदा भुजंगैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः॥
en: And with gigantic elephants roaring, (the place), honoured by pious persons, with its heroes heaving sighs looked exceedingly beautiful like a lake in which serpents are sighing forth.

sa: तत्सखित्वं मया सौम्य रोचयस्व धनेश्वर। तपसा निर्जीतश्चैव सखा भव ममानघ ॥
en: Therefore, O mild one, O lord of riches, do you contract friendship with me. And you have conquered me by your penances. Therefore, O be you my friend.

sa: इह त्वं जातसंवृद्धः साक्षाद्भाता पितुर्मम। कथं दुह्यसि पुत्रस्य पितृव्यो मम राक्षस॥
en: Born and bred in this Rākşasa race, you are the very brother of my father Why, O Rākşasa being my uncle, did you range yourself against your son?

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ तत्र प्रवीरौ पुरुषर्षभौ। शयानौ पुण्डरीकाक्षौ कुमारविव पावकी॥ शरतल्पगतौ वीरौ तथाभूतौ नरर्षभौ। दुःखार्ता करुणं सीता सुभृशं विललाप ह॥
en: Seeing those brothers, foremost of heroes and best of men-having eyes resembling white lotuses, and them selves like to Kumāras, lying in the field,* the fire sprung one, Sītā stricken with grief, beg a to weep piteously. *Virān narashabhān-heroes and best of menoccurs again, left out on the score of redendancy.

sa: प्रकृत्या धर्मशीलस्य रामस्यास्याप्यरोचत। सलक्ष्मणं महातेजाः सुग्रीवं च हरीश्वरम्॥ सत्क्रियाएं क्रियादक्षं स्मितपूर्वमभाषत।
en: And those words pleased Răma, pious by nature. And the highly effulgent (hero) requested, smiling, the active Lakşmaņa and the monkey-chief Sugrīva to collect necessaries for his adoration.

sa: मनर्थकं वै बहुभीतवच्च। अस्मिन्कुले योऽपि भवेन जातः सोऽपीदृशं नैव वदेन कुर्यात्॥
en: Why are you, O uncle, speaking these useless words like one terrified? He even, who is not born in this race, cannot speak or act in this wise.

sa: निशाचरेन्द्रस्य निशम्य वाक्यं स कुम्भकर्णस्य च गर्जितानि। विभीषणो राक्षसराजमुख्यमुवाच वाक्यं हितमर्थयुक्तम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the lord of Rākşasas, as well as the thundering of Kumbhakarņa, Vibhīşaņa addressed the Rākşasa chief, in a pregnant speech, fraught with his welfare.

sa: नैतच्छिथिलया बुद्ध्या त्वं वेत्सि महदन्तरम्। क्व च स्वजनसंवासः क्व च नीचपराश्रयः॥
en: Neither by your character nor yet your understanding did you perceive the mighty difference that Leith between living with one's own kindred, and taking refuge with the base.

sa: समागतासात्र तु नागयक्षा महर्षयश्चक्रचराश्च सिद्धाः। नभः समावृत्य च पक्षिसङ्घा विनेदुरुच्चैः परमप्रहृष्टाः॥
en: There arrived the Nāgas, the Yakşas, the Maharsis, the planets, and the Siddhās, and the birds, covering the the welkin, and, greatly delighted, began to make a noise.

sa: ततः स लम्बस्य गिरेः समृद्ध विचित्रकूटे निपपात कूटे। सकेतकोद्दालकनारिकेले महाभ्रकूटप्रतिमो महात्मा॥
en: That high-souled one resembling a cloudy pavilion, alighted on the (foremost) summit of the splendid mountain, Samva; crested with picturesque peaks; and abounding in ketakas, uddalakas and cocoanuts.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ खङ्गं मुसलसंनिभम्! मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः॥ स ललाटे महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम्। आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्त चचाल ह॥
en: Seeing the sword resembling a mace dropped to the earth, that exceedingly mighty one clenched his fist into a blow like to the levin; and that one, endowed with wondrous energy, smote in the forehead that foremost of monkeys possessed of redoubtable prowess. And thereat he for a moment was staggered.

sa: नैव शक्त्या न गदया नासिना निशितैः शरैः॥ हस्ताभ्यामव संरभ्य हनिष्यामि सवज्रिणम्।
en: No need of the dart, or the mace, or the sword, or whetted arrows. I shall with my bare arms alone slay (Rāma) along with the thunderer himself.

sa: तस्योग्ररूपस्योग्रं त्वं दण्डमाज्ञातुमर्हसि। सीता सम्भाषिता येन वनं तेन विनाशितम्॥ मनः परिगृहीतां तां तव रक्षोगणेश्वर। कः सीतामभिभाषेत यो न स्यात् त्यक्तजीवितः॥
en: It behove you to order sharp chastisement to be inflicted on that one of a fierce form, who, having carried on converse with Sītā, has laid your wood waste. Who, O Sovereign of the Rākşasas, that has not his life served from him, converse with Sītā, who has captivated your heart?"

sa: विक्रमिष्यति रक्षःसु भर्ता ते सहलक्ष्मणः। यथा शत्रुषु शत्रुघ्नो विष्णुना सह वासवः॥
en: And, as Väsava put forth his prowess among his foes, in company with the foe-destroying Visnu, your lord, along with Laksmana, shall display his prowess among the Rākşasa.

sa: एष तं नरशार्दूलो रावणिं निशितैः शरैः। त्याजयिष्यति तत्कर्म ततो वध्यो भविष्यति॥
en: This foremost of men by means of sharpened shafts will make Rāvana's son give up his rites; and then shall he be capable of being slain by us.

sa: रामः कमलपत्राक्षो दैत्यानामिव वासवः। अवजित्य जितक्रोधस्तमचिन्त्यपराक्रमः। रावणं समरे हत्वा भर्ता त्वाधिगमिष्यति॥
en: As Vasava did to the Daityas, the lotus-eyed Rāma, your lord-of controlled anger, and of inconceivable prowess, slaying Rävaņa in battle and thus delivering you, shall approach you.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा मनसा चाधिगम्य ताम्। अवप्लुतो महातेजाः प्राकारं तस्य वेश्मनः॥
en: Having reflected for a while and mentally met with her, that highly energetic one leapt from the wall of Rāvana's mansion on to that (of the Asoka wood).

sa: भरद्वाजाश्रमः श्रीमान्दृश्यते चैष मैथिलि। इयं च दृश्यते गङ्गा पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी॥
en: Behold the beautiful Yamunā, Yamunā, having picturesque forest on its bank and the pleasant hermitage of Bharadvāja. Behold there the sacred river Ganges, dividing itself into three branches.

sa: तां स्त्रियं पश्यतां तेषां ताडयामास राक्षसः। क्रोशन्ती रामरामेति मायया योजितां रथे॥
en: The Räkşasa addressed himself to strike her in the presence of all those monkeys and that illusory figure of Sītā began to bewail saying, “O Rāma! O Rāma!”

sa: र्बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशस्तौ। स चापि तौ तत्र विषादयित्वा ननाद हर्षाधुधि राक्षसेन्द्रः॥
en: Assailed by Indrajit with networks of arrows, they were then sore distressed in the field. And having struck them with sadness, Indrajit from joy shouted in the encounter.

sa: अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाबलः। ह्रस्वं कृत्वा ततो रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह।७७॥
en: Assailed with fearful showers of arrows as with a mass of clouds, that one endowed with eminent strength, decreasing his dimensions, dropped on the top of Ravana's banner.

sa: भरद्वाजाश्रमः श्रीमान्दृश्यते चैष मैथिलि। इयं च दृश्यते गङ्गा पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी॥
en: Behold the beautiful Yamunā, Yamunā, having picturesque forest on its bank and the pleasant hermitage of Bharadvāja. Behold there the sacred river Ganges, dividing itself into three branches.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते नागे वज्रदत्तस्य पाण्डवः। तं न भेतव्यमित्याह ततो भूमिगतं नृपम्॥
en: When the elephant of Vajradatta was prostrated on the ground the so of Pandu, addressing the king who had fallen down with his beast, said, 'Do not fear.'

sa: स च घोरतमो धीमान् गुरुस्त्वं पापचेतसम्। दृष्ट्वा त्वां निर्दहेदद्य क्रोधदीप्तेन चक्षुषा॥
en: My preceptor gifted with great intelligence, is possessed of terrible power. With eyes blazing with anger, he would, if he saw you, have burnt your sinful self today.

sa: यत् तु मामनुशास्तीह भवानद्य हिते स्थितः कर्तास्मि तन्महीपाल निर्वृतो भव पार्थिव॥
en: I shall, certainly, follow those instructions which you have today given, desirous of doing good to me. O lord of Earth. Be you assured of this, O king.

sa: पितापि तव धर्मज्ञ गर्भे तस्मिन् महामते। अवर्धत यथाकामं शुक्लपक्षे यथा शशी॥
en: Your father, O prince, who are conversant with all duties, began to grow in that womb. O you of great intelligence, like the Moon, in the lighted fortnight.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच कस्माद् वागभवत् पूर्वं कस्मात् पश्चान्मनोऽभवत्। मनसा चिन्तितं वाक्यं यदा समभिपद्यते॥
en: The Brahmana's wife said Why did Word first arise and why did Mind arise afterwards, seeing that Word comes into being after having been thought upon by Mind?

sa: सूतमागधसंघेश्च शयानो यः प्रबोध्यते। धरण्यां स नृपः शेते पापस्य मम कर्मभिः॥
en: He was formerly roused from sleep every morning by bands of Sutas and Magadhas had to sleep on the naked earth through the acts of my sinful self.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं प्रयतमानानां वृष्णीनामन्धकैः सह। कालो गृहाणि सर्वेषां परिचक्राम नित्यशः॥
en: Vaishampayana said While the Vrishnis and the Andhakas were thus trying (to avoid the impending calamity), the embodied from of time (death) every day wandered about their houses.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तो मत्स्यमध्यस्थश्च्यवनो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। यो मेऽद्य परमः कामस्तं शृणुध्वं समाहिताः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by them, Chyavana, from among that mass of fishes around him, said Do you with rapt attention hear what my most cherished wish is.

sa: लक्षण्यं गोवृषो यानं यत् प्रधानतमं भवेत्। ब्राह्मण्यास्तद्धरेत् पुत्र एकांशं वै पितुर्धनात्॥
en: The son born of the Brahmani wife shall, in the first place, appropriate from his father's wealth a bull of good marks, and the best car or vehicle.

sa: एवं वै परमं धर्मे प्रशंसन्ति मनीषिणः। प्राणा यथाऽऽत्मनोऽभीष्टा भूतानामपि वै तथा॥
en: This is the high Religion which wise men esteem very highly. The vital airs of other creatures are as dear to them as those of his own self.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच यथोदाहृतमेतत् ते मयि नाम महामुने। नैतद् धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said The explanation you have given me of name, O great ascetic, is beyond the range of my comprehension. Go and plunge into this lake of lotuses.

sa: बलवान् बली। उपक्रीडन्ति तान् राजन्शुभाश्चाप्सरसां गणाः। एताल्लोकानवाप्नोति गां दत्त्वा वै युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bevies of celestial nymphs always amuse there, with music and dance. Indeed, Yudhishthira, a person goes to such regions as the fruit of his making gifts of kine.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तदा कृष्ण मया शिष्यो महातपाः। अगच्छत यथाकामं ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः॥
en: Thus, addressed by me, O Krishna, on that occasion that disciple of mine, gifted with austere penances, that Brahmana of rigid vows, went away according to this pleasure.

sa: एताः पुरा ह्यददन्नित्यमेव शान्तात्मानो दानपथे निविष्टाः। स्ते वै दानं प्रददुश्चैव शक्त्या॥
en: Devoted to the path of gifts, formerly many great persons used to make gifts of kine. Fearing to practise austere penances, they made gifts according to their power.

sa: पर्यायेण प्रवर्तन्ते तत्र तत्र तथा तथा। यत्किंचिदिह लोकेऽस्मिन् सर्वमेते त्रयो गुणाः॥
en: Whatever object exists in this world, everything in it, is fraught with the three qualities. The three qualities act by turns in all things and in all circumstances.

sa: स गां स्पृशतु पादेन सूर्यं च प्रतिमेहतु। अनध्यायेष्वधीयीत बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥
en: Atri said a Let him who has stolen the lotus stalks touch kine with his foot, pass urine facing the sun, and study the Vedas on excluded days.

sa: गाव: ऊचुः बहुले समंगे ह्यकुतोऽभये च क्षेमे च सख्येव हि भूयसी च। यथा पुरा ब्रह्मपुरे सवत्सा शतक्रतोर्वज्रधरस्य यज्ञे।॥ भूयश्च या विष्णुपदे स्थिता ता विभावसोश्चापि पथे स्थिता या। देवाश्च सर्वे सह नारदेन प्रकुर्वते सर्वसहेति नाम॥ मन्त्रेणैतेनाभिवन्देत यो वै विमुच्यते पापकृतेन कर्मणा। लोकानवाप्नोति पुरंदरस्य गवां फलं चन्द्रमसो द्युतिं च
en: The Kine said That man becomes purged off of all his sins who worships a cow with these Mantras. viz., O Bahula, O Samanga, O you who are fearless everywhere, O you who are forgiving and full of auspiciousness, O friend, O source of all plenty, in the region of Brahman, formerly you were present with your calf in the sacrifice of Indra the holder of the thunderbolt! You were stationed in the sky and in the path of Agni! The celestials with Narada among them worshipped you on that occasion by calling you Sarvamsaha! Such a man attains to the region of Purandara. He acquires, besides, the merits that belong to kine, and the splendour of the Moon also.

sa: कालशाकं तु विप्रभ्यो दत्त्वा मर्त्यः समूलकम्। ज्येष्ठायामृद्धिमिष्टां वै गतिमिष्टां स गच्छति॥
en: By making a gift under the constellation Jyeshtha, of the potherb called Kalashaka with the roots, one acquires great prosperity as also such an end as is desirable.

sa: मात्रा पित्रा सुतैारैर्विमुक्तस्य धनेन वा। न भवेद्धि तथा दुःखं यथा गङ्गावियोगजम्॥
en: One who becomes bereaved of mother or father or sons or wives or riches does not feel that grief which one feels when he becomes bereaved of Ganga.

sa: तमुत्सृज यथाशास्त्रं पृथिवीं सागराम्बराम्। स पर्येतु यशो दीप्तं तव पार्थिव दर्शयन्॥
en: Loosening the animal according to the injunctions of the scriptures, let him wander over the whole Earth with her belt of seas, showing your effulgent glory, O king.

sa: शुक्राच्च तात सम्भूतिर्मासस्येह न संशयः। भक्षणे तु महान् दोषो निवृत्त्या पुण्यमुच्यते॥
en: Forsooth, O son, flesh has its origin in the vital seed. There is great sin attaching to its eating, as, indeed, there is merit in abstaining from it.

sa: ततस्तां कश्यपो दृष्ट्वा व्रजन्तीं पृथिवीं तदा। प्रविवेश महीं सद्यो मुक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं समाहितः॥
en: Seeing the goddess Earth about to go, the Rishi Kashyapa himself immediately entered the visibie body of the goddess, renouncing his own body, by the help of Yoga.

sa: तत्र कामगुणैः सर्वैः समुपेतो मुदा युतः। महाभोगो महाकोशो धनी भवति मानवः॥
en: In that life he gets all articles for gratifying his wishes and appetites. Indeed, blessed with the possession of such articles, he gets riches and a wellfilled treasury.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः स नृपस्तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्। शृणु राजन्नगस्त्यस्य माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणस्य ह॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, king Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more spoke to him. Listen now, O king, to the greatness of the Brahmana Agastya.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिगतः सर्वो मानुष्यं यदि गच्छति। स जायते पुल्कसो वा चण्डालो वाप्यसंशयः॥
en: From a brute life one gains the status of humanity. If born as a human being, he is sure to be born as a Pukkasha or a Chandala.

sa: धारिणी सर्वभूतानामयं प्राप्य वरो नृपः। कथमिच्छति मां दातुं द्विजेभ्यो ब्रह्मणः सुताम्॥
en: I am the daughter of Brahman. I hold all creatures. Having obtained me, alas, why does this foremost of kings wish to give me away to the Brahmanas?

sa: स सेनापतिरेवाथ बभौ स्कन्दः प्रतापवान्। ईशो गोप्ता च देवानां प्रियकृच्छङ्करस्य च॥
en: Gifted with mighty power, the celestial general shone in beauty and splendour. The powerful Skanda became the protector of the celestials and did what was agreeable to Shankara.

sa: यथा सर्वश्चतुष्याद् वै त्रिभिः पादै तिष्ठति। तथैवेयं महीपाल कारणैः प्रोच्यते त्रिभिः॥
en: As all quadruped animals are incapable of standing on three legs so the religion of mercy cannot stand if any of those four divisions or parts be wanting.

sa: महर्षेः कश्यपस्यैते गात्रेभ्यः प्रसृतास्तिलाः। ततो दिव्यं गता भावं प्रदानेषु तिलाः प्रभो॥
en: Sesame seeds sprang from the limbs of the great Rishi Kashyapa. Hence in the matter of gifts, they have come to be considered as possessed of great efficacy.

sa: ततः प्रेत्य महाराज मृतो जायति सूकरः। सूकरो जातमात्रस्तु रोगेण म्रियते नृप।॥
en: After leading the life for sometime, he is next born as a hog. As soon as he is born as a hog he has to die of diseasc.

sa: धर्मपुत्रमथाक्षिप्य सक्तुप्रस्थेन तेन सः। मुक्तः शापात् ततः क्रोधो धर्मो ह्यासीद् युधिष्ठिरः।।
en: Dispraising the son of Dharma by a reference to the prastha of powdered barley, Anger became freed from his curse, for Yudhishthira (as Dharma's son) was Dharma's self.

sa: केचिद् ब्रह्ममयं वृक्षं केचिद् ब्रह्मवनं महत्। केचित्तु ब्रह्म चाव्यक्त केचित् परमनामयम्।
en: Some consider Brahman as a tree. Some consider Brahma as a great forest. Some consider Brahina as unmanifest. Some consider it as transcendent and freed from every distress.

sa: भीष्म उवाच उपानही प्रयच्छेद् यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः। मर्दते कण्टकान् सर्वान् विषमान्निस्तरत्यपि॥
en: Bhishma said The man who gives to the Brahmanas sandals for the protection of their feet, succeeds in crushing all thorns and gets over every sort of difficulty.

sa: छागस्तु निधनं प्राप्य पूर्ण संवत्सरे ततः। कीटः संजायते जन्तुस्ततो जायति मानुषः॥
en: After the expiration of a full year, he renounces his goatish body, and is then born as a worm. After that he succeeds in regaining his human form.

sa: वृषदर्भ पुत्र उवाच वरान् ग्रामान् ब्रीहिरसं यवांश्च रत्नं चान्यद् दुर्लभं किं ददानि। नास्मिन्नभक्ष्ये भावमेवं कुरुध्वं पुष्ट्यर्थं वः किं प्रयच्छाम्यहं वै॥
en: The son of Vrishadarbha said Tell me what else I shall give of foremost villages, of grain, of barley, and of even the rarer and more precious jewels. Do not seek to eat this food that is inedible. Tell me what should I give you for the maintenance of your bodies.

sa: विसर्जयति मां राजा गान्धारी च यशस्विनी। भवत्यां बद्धचित्तस्तु कथं यास्यामि दुःखितः॥
en: The king is renouncing me, a also the illustrious Gandhari. My heart, however, is bound to you. How shall I, stricken as I am with sorrow, leave you.

sa: आत्मनश्च सुतानां च दाराणां च धनस्य च। बीजानामोषधीनां च रक्षामेतां प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: By reciting them within a house, all evils are removed from the inmates. By reciting them within a field, the growth of all kinds of crops is helped

sa: स्थावराणि च भूतानि पशवो वाहनानि च। क्रव्यादा दन्दशूकाश्च कृमिकीटविहंगमाः॥ अण्डजा जन्तवश्चैव सर्वे चापि चतुष्पदाः। उन्मत्ता बधिरा मूका ये चान्ये पापरोगिणः॥
en: They become immobile entities, or animals, or beasts of burden; or carnivorous creatures, or snakes, or worms, insects, and birds; or creatures of the oviparous order, or quadrupeds of various species, or lunatics, or deal or bomb human beings, or men who are afflicted by dreadful maladies and considered as unclcan.

sa: प्रायश्चित्तानि सर्वाणि विदितानि च तेऽनघ। राजधर्माश्च ते सर्वे दानधर्माश्च ते श्रुताः॥
en: O sinless one, you are cognizant of all kinds of expiation; and you have also heard of the virtues of kings, as well as the merits of gifts.

sa: यत्वारिंशत् सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते। अष्टमेन तु भक्तेन जीवन् संवत्सरं नृप॥ गवामयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः। हंससारसयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति॥
en: Such a man enjoys every kind of happiness in Heaven for full forty thousand years. He who passes a whole year observing fasts for seven days and taking food on only every eighth day, gains the merit of the Gavamaya sacrifice. The chariot he rides, is drawn by swans and cranes.

sa: मनुष्याणां तु राजन्यः क्षत्रियो मध्यमो गुणः। कुञ्जरो वाहनानां च सिंहचारण्यवासिनाम्॥ अविः पशूनां सर्वेषामहिस्तु बिलवासिनाम्। गवां गोवृषभश्चैव स्त्रीणां पुरुष एव च॥
en: Brahman said Among men, the royal Kshatriya is gifted with the middle quality. Among vehicles, the elephant (is so); and among dwellers of the forest the lion; among all (sacrificial) animals, the sheep; among all those that live in holes, is the snake; among cattle, the bull; among females, the male.

sa: सत्त्वं वैकारिकी योनिरिन्द्रियाणां प्रकाशिका। न हि सत्त्वात् परो धर्मः कश्चिदन्यो विधीयते॥
en: Goodness is the spring which causes the modification of the senses. It is, again, the great enlightener. No duty has been laid down that is higher than Goodness.

sa: अथाख्यास्यामि ते पुत्र श्राद्धेयं विधिमुत्तमम्। स्वयम्भुविहितं पुत्र तत् कुरुष्व निबाध मे॥
en: I shall now tell you, O son, the excellent ordinance laid down in the Shraddhas. Ordained by the SelfCreate himself, O son follow it. Listen to me first.

sa: दक्षैश्च परितो धीर भिषग्भिः कुशलैस्तथा। ददर्श च स तेजस्वी रक्षोनान्यपि सर्वशः॥ द्रव्याणि स्थापितानि स्म विधिवत् कुशलैर्जनैः। तथायुक्तं च तद् दृष्ट्वा जन्मवेश्म पितुस्तव॥
en: It was also surrounded by many well-skilled and clever physicians, O you of great intelligence! Gifted with great energy, he also beheld there all articles that are destructive of Rakshasas, duly placed by persons knowing the subject. Seeing the lying-in-room in which your father was born thus equipt, Hrishikesha became very glad and said, Excellent, Excellent!'

sa: यस्य ह्यन्नमुपाश्नन्ति ब्राह्मणानां शतं दशं। हृष्टेन मनसा दत्तं न स तिर्यग्गतिर्भवेत्॥
en: That man, whose food, given with a cheerful heart, is taken by a is taken by a thousand Brahmanas, has never to take birth in an intermediate order.

sa: मन उवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति भिन्नमर्मा मरिष्यसि॥
en: The mind said These arrows, O Alarka, will never cut me through. They will pierce only your own vital parts. Your vital parts being picrced, you shall die.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तूष्णीमासीदर्जुनस्तु पवनस्त्वब्रवीत् पुनः। शृणु मे ब्राह्मणेष्वेव मुख्यं कर्म जनाधिप॥ मदस्यास्यमनुप्राप्ता यदा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः। तदैव च्यवनेनेह हृता तेषां वसुन्धरा॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of the god of wind, Arjuna remained silent. At this, the god of wind once more addressed him saying, When the dwellers of Heaven, headed by Indra, found themselves within the mouth of the Asura Mada, at that time, Chyavana took away from them the Earth.

sa: यथाकामं व्रजत्येष यज्ञियाश्वो नरर्षभा स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि न स्थानं विद्यते मम॥
en: O foremost of men, this sacrificial horse wanders at will. Blessings on you. I must go away. I have no place to rest for even a short while!

sa: घ्राण उवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति भिन्नमर्मा मरिष्यसि॥
en: The nose said-These arrows will never pass through me, O Alarka! They will pierce only your own vital parts, and your vital parts being pierced, you shall dic.

sa: तं चैवाङ्कगतं दृष्ट्वा बालं पञ्चशिखं पुनः। उमा जिज्ञासमाना वै कोऽयमित्यब्रवीत् तदा॥
en: Seeing that Mahadeva changed into a child with five locks of hair lying on the lap of Parvati, the latter asked the celestials as to who he was.

sa: उत्क्रामद्धिश्च यः प्राणः प्रयतः शिष्टसम्मतः। चिन्तयेन्मनसा गङ्गां स गतिं परमां लभेत्॥
en: The virtuous man with controlled mind, thinks of Ganga at the time when his vital airs are about to leave his body, succeeds in acquiring the highest end.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच जीवः कर्मसमायुक्तः शीघ्रं रेतस्त्वमागतः। स्त्रीणां पुष्पं समासाद्य सूते काले भारत॥
en: Brihaspati said Endued with all his acts, individual soul quickly enters the vital seed, and availing of the menstrual flow of women, takes birth in time, O Bharata.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य जननी भीमस्य विजयस्य च। अनाथवत् कथं दग्ध इति मुह्यामि चिन्तयन्॥
en: How is it that she who was the mother of Yudhishthira, of Bhima, of Vijaya, was brunt to death like helpless creature! Thinking of this I become stupefied.

sa: क्षत्रियाया हरेत् पुत्रश्चतुरोंऽशान् पितुर्धनात्। युद्धावहारिकं यच्च पितुः स्यात्स हरेत् तु तत्॥
en: The son of the Kshatriya wife shall take four of such shares of the paternal property. The son of the Vaishya wife shall take three of such shares.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तदा राजा व्यासेनाद्भुतकर्मणा। भगवानेव नो मान्यो भगवानेव नो गुरुः। भगवानस्य राज्यस्य कुलस्य च परायणम्॥ प्रत्युवाच महातेजा धर्मराजो महामुनिम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Thus addressed at that time by Vyasa of wonderful deeds, king Yudhishthira the just, gifted with mighty energy, said to the great ascetic these words, 'Your holy self is held by us in great reverence. You alone are our preceptor. You alone are the refuge of this our kingdom as also of our family.

sa: एवं सत्सु सदा पश्येत् तत्राप्येषा ध्रुवा स्थितिः। आचारो धर्ममाचष्टे यस्मिशान्ता व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Such conduct one would always see among good persons. Indeed, such conduct lives there for good. That course of practices which persons of tranquil souls follow, indicates Virtue.

sa: उपवास: सदा धर्मो ब्राह्मणस्य च संशयः। स हि धर्मार्थसम्पन्नो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Forsooth, the observance of fasts, is always the duty of the Brahmana. When the Brahmana succeeds in properly observing all his duties, he becomes at one with Brahma.

sa: प्राप्य राज्यानि शतशो महीं जित्वाथ भारत। कोटिशः पुरुषान् हत्वा परितप्ये पितामह॥
en: Having conquered the Earth and acquired hundreds of kingdoms, O Bharata, I turn with grief, O grandfather, at the thought of the millions of men I have killed.

sa: प्रियो भवति दानेन प्रियवादेन चापरः। मन्त्रमूलबलेनान्यो य: प्रियः प्रिय एव सः॥
en: By gift (a man) becomes agreeable; another by sweet speech; a third by the strength of incantations and drugs; but he that is (naturally) agreeable is (always) agreeable.

sa: हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यैर्युध्यस्व पुरुषो भव। पश्य मे धनुषो वीर्यं मानुषस्य निशाचर॥
en: I will kill you together with your advisers. Give battle and play the hero. O night-ranger, behold the strength of my bow though I ar only a mortal.

sa: सान्वितश्च यथाशक्ति पूजितश्च यथाविधि। न चान्यं स द्विजश्रेष्ठः कामयामास वै वरम्॥
en: Though he tried his very best to propitiate him and though he worshipped him duly, yet that best of the twice-born ones did not beg any other boon.

sa: आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे च देवताः। मरुतश्च सहेन्द्रेण दिशश्च दसिगीश्वराः॥
en: And may you be protected by the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Sadhyas the Vishvadevas, the Marutas and the cardinal points together with their guardians and Indra.

sa: शिवास्ते सन्तु पन्थानो मा च ते परिपन्थिनः। आगताच तथा पुत्र भवन्त्वद्रोहचेतसः॥
en: May all your ways be auspicious and unobstructed. And, O son, may the minds of those that may meet with you, be not inclined to enmity towards you.

sa: इदमद्भिः समं प्राप्ता ये केचिद् भुवि जङ्गमाः। प्रविशन्तो महानादं नदन्ति भयपीडिताः॥
en: The few creatures of the earth, who are brought here by the current of the water, when entering the region give out loud shrieks being struck with fear.

sa: शतशो नैर्ऋतान् वन्या जनुर्वन्यांश्च नैर्ऋताः। नैर्ऋतास्तत्र वध्यन्ते प्रायेण न तु वानराः॥
en: The monkeys slew hundreds and Rakshasas and the Rakshasas too killed many dwellers of forest. But the number of Rakshasas killed was greater than that of the monkeys.

sa: सुधारहारेषु च सुधां स्वधाभोजिषु च स्वधाम्। अमृतं चामृताशेषु सुरभी क्षरते पयः॥
en: Surabhi yields milk that is Sudha to those that live on Sudha and Svadha to those who subsist on Svadha and Amrita to those who feed on Amrita.

sa: अन्तर्हितं विदित्वा तं बहुमायं च राक्षसम्॥ रामस्तं देशमागम्य तत् सैन्यं पर्यरक्षत।
en: Knowing that the Rakshasa capable of spreading various illusions, had disappeared, Rama coming up to that place (where the battle was raging) began to carefully protect his army.

sa: तत्र सा ब्राह्मणं गत्वा पृथा शौचपरा सती। विधिवत् परिचारार्ह देववत् पर्यतोषयत्॥
en: And going to the Brahmana there in the fire-room) the chaste Pritha, observant of purity, duly ministering to him as if he were a god, pleased him highly.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच एष गान्धारि पुत्रस्ते दुरात्मा शासनातिगः। ऐश्वर्यलोभादैश्वर्यं जीवितं च प्रहास्यति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Gandhari, this is your wicked-souled son who never obeys my commands owing to his avarice for prosperity; he will lose prosperity as also his life,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा सहस्रांशुः सहसान्तरधीयत। ततः सूर्याय जप्यान्ते कर्णः स्वप्नं न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Saying this, the lord of thousand rays suddenly became invisible. (The next day) Karna after having performed his devotions told the sun of the dreara.

sa: भीमः प्रहरतां श्रेष्ठो वायुपुत्रो महाबलः। धनंजयश्चेन्द्रसुतो न हन्यातां तु कं रणे॥
en: Who is there whom Bhima the foremost among opponents, the son of Vayu and possessed of great strength and Dhananjaya the son of Shakra cannot kill in battle.

sa: अनुज्ञातौ मया वत्स यथेष्टं गच्छ गालवा इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं गालवो मुनिसत्तमम्॥ प्रीतो मधुरया वाचा विश्वामित्रं महाद्युतिम्। दक्षिणाः काः प्रयच्छामि भवते गुरुकर्मणि॥
en: “With my permission, child, go away wherever you wish, O Galava.” Being thus addressed, Galava, the best of Munis, said this in reply, in words which were sweet and pleasing to Vishvamitra endued with great effulgence-"What gift (Dakshina) shall I give to your exalted self for your favour as my preceptor?

sa: दक्षिणआभिरुपेतं हि कर्म सिद्ध्यति मानद। दक्षिणानां हि दाता वै अपवर्गेण युज्यते॥
en: Every religions act becomes successful only when it is accompanied by a gift, O you the giver of honours and then the giver of those gifts obtains salvation.

sa: सहायवति सर्वार्थाः संतिष्ठन्तीह सर्वशः। किं नु तस्याजितं संख्ये यस्य भ्राता धनंजयः॥
en: In this world, he, that is backed up, has all his desires gratified. What is there that cannot be overcome by him in battle whose brother is Dhananjaya?

sa: दिवापि मयि निष्क्रान्ते संतष्येते गुरू मम। विचिनोति हि मां तातः सहैवाश्रमवासिभिः॥
en: Even if I go out during the day my parents are filled with anxiety. And my father together with all the inhabitants of the hermitages searches for me.

sa: संज्ञां च स पुनर्लब्ध्वा सावित्रीमभ्यभाषत। प्रोष्यागत इव प्रेम्णा पुनः पुनरुदीक्ष्य वै॥
en: Having regained his consciousness, he looked at her again and again like one returned from a distant clime (after a long time) and (then) endearingly addressed her thus.

sa: स राजा तस्य राजर्षेः कृत्वा पूजां यथार्हतः। वाचा सुनियतो भूत्वा चकारात्मनिवेदनम्॥ तस्यार्थ्यमासनं चैव गां चावेद्य स धर्मवित्। किमागमनमित्येवं राजा राजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: The King (Ashvapati) having in conformity with usage, paid his respects to that royal sage, introduced himself (to him) by an appropriate speech and the king (Dyumatsena) versed in religion, having offered to the monarch (Ashvapati) a seat, (the oblation called) Arghya and a cow asked him what brought him there,

sa: पाण्डवांश्चैव मत्स्यांश्च पाञ्चालान् केकयैः सह। सात्यकिं वासुदेवं च श्रोतासि विजितान् मया।॥
en: You will be the hearer of the defeat by me of the Pandavas and Matsyas and the Panchalas with the Kaikeyas and Satyaki and the son of Vasudeva.

sa: सा तौ तदाब्रवीत् तुष्टा पतगेन्द्रद्विजर्षभौ। न भेतव्यं सुपर्णोऽसि सुपर्ण त्यज सम्भ्रमम्॥
en: She, thus spoken to, was gratified with the chief of birds and said "Do not fear, O Suparna, become possessed of beautiful wings and leave aside your fears.

sa: इच्छेयमभ्यनुज्ञाता आर्यया श्वशुरेण ह। अनेन सह निर्गन्तुं न मेऽद्य विरहः क्षमः॥
en: It is my desire that your worshipful self and my father-in-law will (kindly) permit me to accompany him. I cannot bear to be separated (from him) this day.

sa: ततः सत्यवतः कायात् पाशबद्धं वशं गतम्। अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं पुरुषं निश्चकर्ष यमो बलात्॥
en: Then Yama powerfully drew out of the body of Satyavana a person of the measure of the thumb, bound him with the noose and brought him under control.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच दैवतं त्वाभिजानामि वपुरेतद्ध्यमानुषम्। कामया ब्रूहि देवेश कस्त्वं किं च चिकीर्षसि॥
en: Savitri said: From your superhuman appearance I know you to be a god. Kindly tell me, O god of gods, who you are and what is your desire.

sa: असंतोषः परीतापो दृष्ट्वा दीप्ततराः श्रियः। यद् भवत्यवरे स्थाने स्थितानां तत् सुदुष्करम्॥
en: The discontent and regret that must follow ones stay in an inferior place after he has enjoyed more auspicious and effulgent regions must be very difficult to bear.

sa: संजय उवाच वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। उवाच काले दुर्धर्षो वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard the speech of Vasudeva, Dhananjaya the son of Kunti and hard to be vanquished said at the proper time within the hearing of Vasudeva.

sa: गच्छ जानीहि सौम्येमां कस्य वात्र कुतोऽपि वा। किमर्थमागता सुभूरिदं कण्टकितं वनम्॥
en: O gentle sir, go and enquire who she is and whence she has come and why she, of fine eyebrows, has come to this forest full of thorns.

sa: शल्य उवाच प्रविश्यापस्ततो वह्निः ससमुद्राः सपल्वलाः। आससाद सरस्तच्च गूढो यत्र शतक्रतुः॥
en: Shalya said Agni (the god of fire) thus having entered the waters including the seas and the small lakes, came to the lake where Shakra lay in disguise.

sa: विष्वक्सेन कुरून् गत्वा भरताञ्छमयन् प्रभो। यथा सर्वे सुमनसः सह स्याम सुचेतसः॥
en: Going to the Kurus, establish such peace among the sons of Bharata, O Lord, that we may live with all of them with cheerful minds and in contentment.

sa: कदां भ्रामयतस्तस्य भिन्दतो हस्तिमस्तकान्। सृक्किणी लेलिहानस्य वाष्यमुत्सृजतो मुहुः॥ उद्दिश्य नागान् पततः कुर्वतो भैरवान् रवान्। प्रतीपं पततो मत्तान् कुञ्जरान् प्रतिगर्जतः॥ विगाह्य रथमार्गेषु वरानुद्दिश्य निघ्नतः। अग्नेः प्रज्वलितस्येव अपि मुच्येत मे प्रजा॥
en: Whirling the mace and piercing the heads of elephants, licking the corners of his lips and giving out (terrific) breaths every moment, making terrific noises in return of those of falling elephants and rushing with loud roars against elephants coming against him, having penetrated into the place where the chariots stand, when he kills the heroes after taking aim against them, will one of my soldiers escape from him who is blazing like fire?

sa: विदुर उवाच देवव्रत निबोधेदं वचनं मम भाषतः। प्रणष्टः कौरवो वंशस्त्वयाऽयं पुनरुद्भूतः॥
en: Vidura said O you of divine vows, listen to these words spoken by me; this race of Kurus made extinct by you, had again been saved from extermination.

sa: जाम्बूनदमयी वेदी ध्वजे यस्य प्रदृश्यते। तस्य दक्षिणतो याहि कृपः शारद्वतो यतः॥
en: Do you go where Kripa, the son of Sharadvata is, by the southern side of the car the flag of which has an emblem of a golden altar.

sa: आरुज्य वृक्षान् निर्मूलान् गजः परिरुजनिव। निघ्नन् पद्भिः क्षिति भीम निष्टनन् परिधावसि॥
en: Like an elephant breaking into pieces the uprooted trees which he has himself felled down and beating the earth with its feet, you too run about drawing sighs.

sa: कर्तव्यं चेत् प्रियं मह्यं वध्यः स पुरुषाधमः। सैन्धवापसदः पापो दुर्मतिः कुलपांसनः॥
en: “If you wish to encompass my pleasure, that vile, wretch of a man, the wicked-minded, infamous and despicable king of the Saindhava race should be killed by you.

sa: दुर्योधन निबोधेदं कुलार्थं यद् ब्रवीमि ते। तच्छ्रुत्वा राजशार्दूल स्वकुलस्य हितं कुरु॥
en: O Duryodhana, listen to these words, which I say for the benefit of my race and hearing that, O best among kings, effect the benefit of your race.

sa: उक्तवान् हि भवान् सर्वं वचनं कुरुमुख्ययोः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य तेषां हि वचनं कुरुसंसदि॥
en: You have already told us all the world spoken by the principal members of the Kuru race in the assembly of the Kurus to the son of Dhritarashtra,

sa: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ किं शेषे भीमसेन यथा मृतः। नामृतस्य हि पापीयान् भार्यामालभ्य जीवति॥
en: O Bhimasena, rise up, why do you sleep like a dead one? For a sinful wretch cannot live after insulting the wife of one that is not dead.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सेनापतिं चक्रे विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणम्। धृतराष्ट्रात्मजो भीष्मं सोऽभिषिक्तो व्यरोचत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did the son of Dhritarashtra make Bhishma, who had made liberal gifts, the commander of his army, and he too being duly installed blazed forth.

sa: राजर्षीणां पुराणानां मार्गमन्विच्छ भारत। दाने तपसि सत्ये च भव तात युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O son of Bharata, follow in the path of the great Rishi, king of old and O my son Yudhishthira, be their equal in liberality, devotion and truth,

sa: येन खट्वां समारूढः परितप्येत कर्मणा। आदावेव न तत् कुर्यादध्रुवे जीविते सति॥
en: That act which is sure to be repented for when a man enters the Vale of Death should never be done from the very beginning in this life.

sa: पृथिवी तस्य राष्ट्रं च यस्य भीमो महारथः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च माधवः॥
en: Let the earth and kingdom be his who has on his side the great car-warrior Bhima, and Nakula and Sahadeva, and the five sons of Draupadi, O Madhava,

sa: या चैव फलनिर्वृत्तिः सौहृदे चैव यत् सुखम्। यतते चापवादाय यत्नमारभते क्षये।॥
en: As also the results of connection and the happiness derived from it. They (the lowminded) then try to speak ill (of their late friend) and injure him. are

sa: उभौ शिष्यौ हि मे वीरौ गदायुद्धविशारदौ। दुल्यस्नेहोऽस्म्यतो भीमे तथा दुर्योधने नृपे॥
en: Both of these heroes, well skilled in fighting with maces, are my pupils and I bear the same affection for Duryodhana as for that ruler of men Bhima.

sa: दुःशासनभुजं श्यामं संछिन्नं पांसुगुण्ठितम्। यद्यहं तु न पश्यामि का शान्तिर्हदयस्य मे॥
en: If I do not see the dark-coloured hand of Dushasana torn off from his body and reduced to powder, then what peace shall there be in my heart?

sa: किरतोः शरजालानि वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥ न स्म सूर्यस्तदा भाति न च वाति समीरणः।
en: The sun then did not pour its rays and the wind did not blow. And they covered each other with a net-work of arrows, like Vritra and Vasava.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे पराक्रान्ता जिगीषवः। तथैवाभिसरास्तेषां त्यक्तात्मानो जये धृताः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said As the sons of Pandu are all powerful and desirous of victory, so are their followers who are self-sacrificing and have set their mind on victory.

sa: रामं तु गतमाज्ञाय राजानं च तथागतम्। आनाय्य भरतं देवी कैकेयी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: And seeing that Rama had left for the forest and that the king had breathed his last, Kaikeyi causing Bharata to be brought, addressed to him these words.

sa: अभिवाद्याथ सा कृष्ण त्वया मद्वचनाद् विभो। धृतराष्ट्रश्च कौरव्यौ राजानश्च वयोऽधिकाः॥ भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं चैव महाराजं च बाह्निकम्। द्रौणिं च सोमदत्तं च सर्वांश्च भरतान् प्रति॥ विदुरं च महाप्राज्ञं कुरूणां मन्त्रधारिणम्। अगाधबुद्धिं मर्मज्ञं स्वजेथा मधुसूदन॥
en: Then, O Krishna, having greeted her on my behalf, O Lord and also Dhritarashtra and the kings on the side of the Kurus and those who are my seniors in age and Bhishma and Drona and Kripa and the great king Balhika and the son of Drona and Somadatta and all the Bharatas and the exceedingly wise Vidura, the adviser of the Kurus, O slayer of Madhu, that man of illimitable knowledge and conversant with the rulers of morality should be embraced by you.

sa: स निश्चित्य ततः कृत्यं स्वसारमुपसान्त्व्य च। ऊर्ध्वमाचक्रमे राजा विधाय नगरे विधिम्॥
en: Then king (Ravana) settling as to what course to adopt and making arrangements for the protection of his capital and consoling his sister, rose up in the air.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सत्कृत्य वार्ष्णेयं विराटः पृथिवीपतिः। गृहान् प्रस्थापयामास सगणं सहबान्धवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then the lord of the earth Virata, having treated the descendant of Vrishni with due honours, sent him home along with his men and his friends.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स राजानं धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। प्रचक्रमे निधानाय शस्त्राणां भरतर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having spoken thus the king Yudhishthira, the virtuous Arjuna, O best of the Bharata race, prepared for putting aside the weapons on that tree. W to

sa: भ्रातरं घातयित्वा कस्त्यक्त्वा रणशिरच कः। त्वदन्यः कः पुमान् सत्सु ब्रूयादेवं व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Having seen his younger brother slain, what other man except you, would retreat from the battle-field, and then boast as you do in the midst of good men?

sa: एतच्च पूर्वं कार्यं नः सुनीतमभिकाङ्क्षताम्। अन्यथा ह्याचरन् कर्म पुरुषः स्यात् सुबालिशः॥
en: It ought to be done first of all by us, who desire to act on the principles of politics and the man who acts otherwise is a fool.

sa: यो वै गृहेभ्यः प्रवसन् प्रियाणां नानुसंस्मरेत्। दुःखेन सुखमन्विच्छेत् स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥
en: He alone, can live in a royal palace, who, although staying away from home, never remembers his beloved ones and suffers misery in the expectation of future happiness.

sa: अज्ञातचर्या बालानामवरोधश्च माधवा न मे क्लेशतमं तत् स्यात् पुत्रैः सह परंतप॥
en: O Madhava, O chastiser of foes, living in concealment and the deprivation of my boys, could not be so painful to me in the company of my sons?

sa: तादृशा हि सहाया वै पुरुषस्य बुभूषतः। इष्टं जिहीर्षतः किंचित् सचिवाः शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: Such are the fitting allies of a man seeking his welfare and desirous of attaining what he wants and are also good councillors, 0 chastiser of your foes.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा प्रारुदत् सीता कम्पयन्ती पयोधरौ॥ शिरोधरां च तन्वङ्गी मुखं प्रच्छाद्य वाससा।
en: Saying (all) this, that lady of delicate limbs Sita, with her breasts and neck trembling (in emotion) and covering her face with her clothes, began to weep profusely.

sa: एकः कर्णः पराञ्जेतुं समर्थं इति निश्चितम्। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेः स शमं नोपयास्यति॥
en: It is the conviction of the son of Dhritarashtra of mean intelligence, that Karna alone is capable of defeating the enemy and he will not agree to peace.

sa: त्वत्तो विशिष्टं वीर्येण धनुष्यमरराट्समम्। वासुदेवसमं युद्धे तं पार्थं को न पूजयेत्॥
en: Who will not praise Partha, who is superior to yourself in prowess, equal to the king of the gods in bowmanship and equal to Vasudeva himself in battle?

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः अधर्मे सम्प्रवृत्तस्त्वं धर्मं न प्रतिपद्यसे। प्रमाणमेतदस्माकं पूर्वं प्रोक्तं महर्षिभिः॥
en: The Rishis said You are going along the path of vice; you do not act virtuously. “That they are authentic" has before been said by our great Rishis.

sa: शतयोजनविस्तारं न शक्ताः सर्ववानराः। क्रान्तुं तोयनिधिं वीरा नैषा वो नैष्ठिकी मतिः॥
en: O heroes, all the monkeys will not be able to cross the sea which is a hundred yojanas in width. Therefore, your proposal cannot be agreeable to reason.

sa: एवं सर्वमहिंसायां धर्मार्थमपिधीयते। अमृतः स नित्यं वसति यो हिंसां न प्रपद्यते॥
en: Similarly, every other duty and observance is encompassed within the one duty of abstention froin injury. He who avoids injuring other creatures, lives an eternal life of joy.

sa: प्रथमं यः समाख्यातः शीलवानिति संसदि। न वाच्यं तस्य वैगुण्यं प्रतिज्ञां परिरक्षता॥
en: If one speaks of a particular person before others of righteous conduct, one should not, if desirous of keeping one's consistency, afterwards describe the same person as wicked.

sa: तत् परे नान्वबुध्यन्त सैन्येन रजसा वृताः॥ तावकाः प्रद्रुता राजन् दुर्योधनमृते नृपम्।
en: The enemy, however, did not see it for the Kuru army was then covered with a cloud of dust. All your warriors fled, O king, except king Duryodhana.

sa: संजय उवाच उपावृत्ताश्च पीताश्च पुनर्युज्ययन्तु मे रथे। तस्य सर्वानुपासंगान् सर्वोपकरणानि च॥
en: Sanjaya said Then king Yudhishthira directed quivers full of shafts and various other kinds of weapons and all other necessaries, to be placed in the chariot of Satyaki.

sa: दुर्जेयः स परो धर्मस्तथाधर्मश्च दुर्विदः॥ युध्यस्व कौरवैः सार्धं मा गा पितृनिवेशनम्।
en: Thus morality is a mystery, as also immorality is difficult of being ascertained. Fight on with the Kauravas and do not return to the home of your fathers.

sa: नकुल उवाच विशाखयूपे देवानां सर्वेषामग्नयश्चिताः। तस्माद् विद्धि महाराज देवाः कर्मफले स्थिताः॥
en: Nakula said Even the gods had placed their fires in the reign called Vishakha-yupa, Know, therefore, O king, that the gods themselves depend upon the fruits of action!

sa: इत्युक्तः स तदा दूतः पाण्डुपुत्रेण धीमता। जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते देवराजः शतक्रतुः॥
en: Thus addressed by the intelligent son of Pandu, the celestial messenger returned to the place where the king of the celestials was, viz., he of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: अक्षतौ संयुगे तत्र प्रविष्टौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। न च वारयिता कश्चित् तयोरस्तीह संजय॥
en: Krishna and the son of Pandu have both entered into our troops, receiving not even the slightest wound. O Sanjaya, there is none also who can resist them.

sa: अविशेषाणि चान्यानि कर्मयुक्तानि यानि तु। उभयत्र मनो ज्ञेयं बुद्धिस्तु द्वादशी भवेत्॥
en: The rest, however, which are connected with action, are without distinction. The mind should be considered as belonging to both. The understanding is the twelfth in the top.

sa: कल्याणी रूपसम्पन्ना दुर्भगा शक्र दृश्यते। अलक्षणा विरूपा च सुभगा दृश्यते परा॥
en: An auspicious and beautiful woman, O Shakra, is seen to pass her life miserably. Likewise, ugly woman with every inauspicious mark is seen to live in great happiness.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततश्चतुर्दशी रामः समयेन महामनाः। दर्शयामास तान् विप्रान्धर्मराजं च सानुजम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then on the fourteenth day of noon, the high-souled Rama at the proper hour appeared before the Brahinanas and Dharınaraja (Yudhishthira) with his younger brothers.

sa: षोडशी तु कला सूक्ष्मा स सोम उपधार्यताम्। न तूपयुज्यते देवैर्देवानुपयुनक्ति सा॥
en: That sixteenth portion is subtile. It should be known as Soma. It is never upheld by the senses. On the other hand, the senses are upheld by it.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कानि पण्यानि विक्रीय स्वर्गलोकान्न हीयते। ब्राह्मणो वैश्यधर्मेण वर्तयन् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Yudhishthira said "If a Brahmana, O foremost of Bharata's race, follows the duties of a Vaishya, what articles may he sell without losing his chance of attaining heaven?"

sa: संहत्य धर्मं चरतां पुराऽऽसीत् सुखमेव तत्। तेषां नासीद् विधातव्यं प्रायश्चित्तं कथंचन॥
en: Uniting together they used to celebrate meritorious acts. In this they found great happiness. And inasmuch as they never transgressed, they had never to perform any expiatory rite.

sa: यो न शक्यः सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा। सोऽयं कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो मृत्यु मन लम्भितः॥
en: He, who was incapable of being killed by the celestials, Yaksas and Asuras, has met with death like one devoid of prowess at the hands of a mortal.

sa: ततो दोर्योधनं सैन्यं मुदा परमया युतम्। ऋतेऽर्जुनं भृशं क्रुद्ध धर्मराजस्य निग्रहे॥
en: on Thereafter the army of Duryodhana highly delighted at the absence of Arjuna from Yudhishthira's side, became infuriated at the thought of the capture of the virtuous monarch.

sa: भीमं च भीमविक्रान्तं प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियं मम। अर्जुनं चेन्द्रसंकाशं यमौ चैव यमोपमौ॥ द्रष्टुमिच्छामि तां चाहं पाञ्चालीं धर्मचारिणीम्। न चेह स्थातुमिच्छामि सत्यमेवं ब्रवीमि वः॥
en: Bhima also of dreadful prowess and dearer to me than my life. Arjuna too, resembling Indra himself, the twins also who resembled the Destroyer the Destroyer himself in prowess, I wish to see ! I wish to see the princess of Panchala, of good conduct, I wish not to stay here. I tell you the truth.

sa: महता तपसा देवस्तपिष्णुः सेवितो मया। प्रीतेन चाहं विभुना सूर्येणोक्तस्तदानघ॥ वरं वृणीष्व विप्रर्षे यदिष्टं ते सुदुर्लभम्। तत् ते दास्यामि प्रीतात्मा मत्प्रसादो हि दुर्लभः॥
en: With the hardest penances i formerly adored the heat-giving god. O sinless one, pleased with me, the powerful Sun, addressed me, saying, O regenerate Rishi, pray for the boon you covet, however difficult it may be of acquisition. I shall, with cheerful mind, grant it to you. It is very difficult to make me grant grace.

sa: एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन विशेषो नात्र दृश्यते। तद् यथावद् यथान्यायं भगवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे॥
en: No difference, therefore, is seen between them about either their superiority or inferiority of power. O illustrious one do you, then, clear out the mystery and enlighten me.

sa: यां विप्राः सर्वतः शान्ता विशुद्धा ज्ञाननिश्चयाः। गतिं गच्छन्ति संतुष्टास्तामाहुः परमां गतिम्॥
en: That, indeed, is considered as the highest end which is acquired by Brahmanas gifted with wisdom, withdrawn from all acts, possessed of purity and the surety of knowledge.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा परिष्वज्य दैत्यास्तं राजकुञ्जरम्। समाश्वास्य च दुर्धर्षं पुत्रवद् दानवर्षभाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus addressed him, the Daityas embraced that foremost of kings; and those best of the Danavas then cheered that irrepressible hero like a son.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच नेह पश्यामि विबुधा राधेयममितौजसम्। भ्रातरौ च महात्मानौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥ जुहुवुर्ये शरीराणि रणवह्नौ महारथाः। राजानो राजपुत्राश्च ये मदर्थे हता रणे॥
en: Yudhishthira said “You deities, I do not see here Radha's son of incomparable prowess, as also my largehearted brothers, and and Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, those great car-warriors who poured their bodies (as libations on the fire of battle, those kings and princess who met with death for my sake in battle.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य ग्रहणाद् गन्धर्वेण बलात् प्रभो। स्त्रीणां बाह्याभिमर्शाच्च हतं भवति नः कुलम्॥
en: O exalted one, from this forcible seizure of Duryodhana and from this insult offered to the ladies of our family by a stranger, our family honour is destroyed,

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दिष्ट्याधनंजयास्त्राणि त्वया प्राप्तानि भारत। दिष्ट्या चाराधितो राजा देवानामीश्वरः प्रभुः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O Dhananjaya, fortunately you have obtained these celestials weapons and it is by good luck too, that you have worshipped the lord king of the celestials.

sa: भार्यां पतिः सम्प्रविश्य स यस्माजायते पुनः। जायायास्तद्धि जायात्वं पौराणाः कवयो विदुः॥
en: The learned men of old say that the husband himself, entering into the womb of his wife, comes out as the son. Therefore, the wife is called Jaya.

sa: शरावरौ शरैः पूर्णौ विध्वस्तौ पश्य लक्ष्मण ॥ प्रतोदाभीषुहस्तोऽयं कस्य वा सारथिर्हतः।
en: Behold, O Laksmana, these two quivers have been totally spoiled though filled with arrows. whose charioteer is this who has been killed with reins and lash in hands?

sa: तान्विनिर्जित्य काकुत्स्थ गन्धर्वनगरं शुभम्॥ निवेशय महाबाहो स्वे पुरे सुसमाहिते। अन्यस्य न गतिस्तत्र देशः परमशोभनः। रोचतां ते महाबाहो नाहं त्वामहितं वदे॥
en: Having hoisted your flag of victory and conquered that highly picturesque city of Gandharvas do you include that kingdom within your well-established territories. None can enter there. O you having long arms, I do not request you for any harm of you. Let that highly charming country be liked by you.

sa: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रो राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह॥ क्व सीतेति निरीक्षन् वै बाष्पसंरुद्धया गिरा। एवमुक्ता नरेन्द्रेण ते मृगाः सहसोत्थिताः॥ दक्षिणाभिमुखाः सर्वे दर्शयन्तो नभः स्थलम्।
en: Beholding them, Rāghava, the best of men, looked at them and said in accents choked with vapour-Where is Sītā? Being thus addressed by that Lord of men the deer rose up all on a sudden and looked up to the sky facing the south and proceeded to the direction by which Maithili had been carried away.

sa: सवृद्धबालेष्वथवा पार्थिवेषु महात्मसु। को नाईं मन्यते कृष्णं को वाप्येनं न पूजयेत्॥
en: Who is there among the young or the old or among these illustrious kings who does not consider Krishna worthy of worship, or who does not worship Krishna?

sa: सा भीमवेगा समराभिकाङ्गिणी सुदारुणा राक्षसवीरसेना। तौ राजपुत्रौ सहसाभ्युपेता माला ग्रहाणामिव चन्द्रसूर्यो।।
en: Then as the planets dart towards the sun and moon, that heroic and dreadful army of Rākşasas, eager for victory suddenly rushed towards the princes with great vehemence.

sa: अन्धं स्यात् तम एवेदं न प्रज्ञायेत किंचन। चातुर्वण्र्यं न वर्तेत धर्माधर्मावृतानृते॥
en: Without the Brahmana, all would be darkness. Nothing would be known. The four castes would not exist. The distinction between virtue and sin, Truth and Untruth, would disappear.

sa: स पार्थमुक्तैरिषुभिः प्रणुन्नो गजो गजेनेव जितस्तरस्वी। विहाय संग्रामशिरः प्रयातो वैकर्तनः पाण्डवबाणतप्तः॥
en: Thus wounded by the arrows shot by Partha, the son of Pandu, Vikartana's son lef the battle-field and took to his heels like a elephant defeated by another.

sa: तेन त्वां निहनिष्यामि सानुबन्धं सबान्धवम्। समीकरिष्ये तत् पापं यत् पुरा कृतवानसि॥
en: For all these act of yours, I will, this day, slay you with all your relations, and will avenge all those wrongs you did formerly inflict on us".

sa: स तु ववे वरं राजन् स्यामहं ब्राह्मणास्त्विति॥ तथेति चाब्रवीद् ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः।
en: The boon that Vishvamitra prayed for was that he should be permitted to become a Brahmana. Brahmana, the grandfather of all the worlds, said to him-"So be it.'

sa: स भीष्मः सुसमर्थोऽयमस्माभिः सहितो रणे। परान् विजेतुं तस्मात् ते व्येतु भीर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: That Bhishma is well capable to fight along with us and to conquer to enemies; therefore, O bull among the race of Bharata, let your fears be dispelled.

sa: शरेण कार्तस्वरभूषितेन दिवाकराभेण सुसंहितेन। हृतोत्तमाङ्गो युधि पाण्डवेन पपात भूमौ सुबलस्य पुत्रः॥
en: Deprived of head by the son of Pandu with that gold-decked and sharp arrow, effulgent like the Sun, Subala's son dropped down on the earth in that battle.

sa: तत्र स्म गाथा गायन्ति क्षीबा हृष्टाः पठन्ति च। नाभागस्तुतिसंयुक्ता ननृतुश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Some perfectly toxicated sang songs and were greatly delighted; and some reeled on the ground; some applauded the son of Nabhaga in panegyrics and some danced in thousands.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति नैवात्र भयं व्यालाद् भविष्यति। अपि चाल्पेन कालेन फलं प्राप्स्यति पुष्कलम्॥
en: From this day there will be no fear in this tirtha from serpents and wild beasts. By the slightest of endeavours, again, one shall reap great results here."

sa: दुपदोऽपि महान् राजा कृतवैस्च नः पुरा। तस्य संग्रहणं राजन् स्वपक्षस्य विवर्धनम्॥
en: O king, we have formerly waged a great war with the king of Drupada; if we can now secure him as an ally, it will strengthen our party.

sa: कणिक उवाच शृणु राजन् यथावृत्तं वने निवसतः पुरा॥ जम्बुकस्य महाराज नीतिशास्त्रार्थदर्शिनः।
en: Kanika said: O king, hear what happened in the days of yore. O great king, there dwelt in the forest a jackal well-acquainted with the science of politics.

sa: माता सती पाण्डवानां पञ्चानां मध्यतः स्थिता। तृष्णया हि परीतास्मि पुत्रान् भृशमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: "I am the mother of the five Pandavas though I am now in their midst, yet I am burning in thirst!” She repeatedly said this to her sons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्नार्टिषेणो द्विजोत्तमः। वसन् गुरुकले नित्यं नित्यमध्ययने रतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Formerly, in the Krita age, O king, there was a great Rishi called Arshtishena. Living in his preceptor's house, he attended to his lessons every day.

sa: क्षते क्षारं स हि ददौ पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः। पार्थोऽपि भृशंसंविद्धो ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः॥
en: Thus he seemed to pour acid upon the wounds of the illustrious son of Pandu; thus deeply pierced, Pritha's son caught hold of his flag-staff for supporting himself.

sa: ततो देवर्षयः सर्वे तथा सप्तर्षयोऽपि च। ब्रह्मर्षयश्च विजयं जेपुः पार्थस्य धीमतः॥
en: Then the celestial Rishis, the seven Rishis, and the twice-born Rishis, became engaged in silent recitations from desire of giving victory to the highly intelligent son of Pritha's.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत्रापि तपसि श्रेष्ठे वर्तमानः स वीर्यवान्। सिद्धचारणसव्रनां बभूव प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That greatly powerful man (Pandu; was there engaged in the best of asceticism) and he soon became the favorite of all the Siddhas and Charanas.

sa: विषमस्थेन मूढेन परिभ्रष्टसुखेन च। यत् सा तेन परित्यक्ता तत्र न क्रोधुमर्हति॥
en: Because she has been abandoned by one, who himself has fallen in distress and who is foolish and deprived of all happiness. She, therefore, should not be angry.

sa: जरितोवाच इदमाखोर्बिलं भूमौ वृक्षस्यास्य समीपतः। तदाविशध्वं त्वरिता वढेरत्र न वो भयम्॥
en: Jarita said: There is a hole here in the ground near to this tree; enter this hole without any delay; you shall then have no fear from fire.

sa: व्यक्तं दैवादहं मन्ये राघवस्य विनाभवम्। वैदेह्या सारथे नित्यं दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥
en: It is clear to me, O Sumantra, that this separation of Rāma, has been brought about by the influence of destiny-for it is hard to get over accident.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच एवमुक्तस्य केशिन्या नलस्य कुरुनन्दन। हृदयं व्यथितं चासीदश्रुपूर्णे च लोचने॥
en: Brihadashva said : O descendant of the Kuru race, hearing these words of Keshini, Nala's heart became afflicted with grief; and his eyes, too, were filled with tears.

sa: तं मत्तमातङ्गविलासगामी गच्छन्तमव्यग्रमना महात्मा। स लक्ष्मणो राघवमिष्टचेष्टो ररक्ष धर्मेण बलेन चैव॥
en: And the high-souled Lakşmaņa, of unagitated mind, intent upon Rāma's welfare and wending like to an infuriated elephant, cheered him up by means of moral and heroic counsels.

sa: चिन्तयानां विमोक्षं वो नाधिगच्छामि किंचन। छादयिष्यामि वो गात्रैः करिष्ये मरणं सह॥
en: Even after good deal of reflection, I do not see any way of escape for you. I shall now cover you with my wings and die with you.

sa: यच्छ्रुत्वा पूतमात्मानं विजानामि तपोधन। प्रहृष्टानि च रोमाणि प्रसन्नं च मनो मम॥
en: O you having asceticism for your wealth, I consider myself cleansed by having listened to this account. My hair stands on end and my mind has become cheerful.

sa: अपानपा न गदितास्तथान्ये ये द्विजातयः। जपन्ति संहितां सम्यक् ते नित्यं तारणक्षमाः॥
en: Those Brahmanas who abstain from drink and who are never spoken by others as having any fault and who daily read the Samhitas are capable of saving others,

sa: तं तु वैवाहिकं दृष्ट्वा कन्येयं समुपार्जितम्। अब्रवीत् तत्र गाङ्गेयं मन्त्रिमध्ये द्विजर्षभ॥
en: This girl, seeing all the arrangements made for the wedding, said there to the son of Ganga in the midst of his councillors, O best among the twice-born.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे सैन्धवे सव्यसाचिना। मामका यदकुर्वन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The heroic king of Sindhu being killed by that one who could draw the bow with his left hand (i.e., Arjuna), relate to me O Sanjaya,

sa: अपरे मोहिता मोहात् तमेवाभिमुखा ययुः। पाण्डवानां रणे योधाः परलोकं गताः परे॥
en: Others, on the other hand, were confounded that they rushed even towards Drona himself. Indeed many warriors of the Pandava host were then dispatched to the other world.

sa: क्रोधहर्षावनादृत्य पैशुन्यं च विशेषतः। विप्रो वेदानधीते यः स त्यागी पार्थ उच्यते॥
en: That Brahmana who, disregarding anger and joy, and especially deceitfulness, always devotes his time to the study of the Vedas, is a Renouncer observing the vow of mendicancy.

sa: तां नामृष्यत कौरव्यो गदां प्रतिहतां रणे॥ मत्तो द्विप इव क्रुद्धः प्रतिकुञ्जरदर्शनात्।
en: The Kuru prince could not see his own mace thus baffled in that attack. He was enraged like an infuriate elephant at the sight of a rival elephant.

sa: यस्य दण्डभयात् सर्वे भूतग्रमाः समागताः। धर्ममेवानुरुध्यन्ति का तं न वरयेत् पतिम्॥
en: What lady will not accept him as her husband, by the terror of whose club all the assembled creatures are propelled to walk in the path of virtue!

sa: अस्माकं भयभीतानां नित्यशो भगवान् गतिः। ततस्त्वार्ताः प्रयाग्रमो वरं त्वां वरदो ह्यसि॥
en: O exalted one, whenever we are beset with danger, it is you from whom we ask for a boon, for you always grant the boon asked of you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अश्वास्तित्तिरिकल्माषान् गान्धर्वान् हेममालिनः। ददौ चित्ररथस्तुष्टो यांस्तान् गाण्डीवधन्वने॥ युद्धे जितः पराभूतः प्रीतिपूर्वमरिंदमः। एतद् राजन् मम धनं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Yudhishthira said The steeds of the Tittiri, Kalmasha and Gandharva breeds, adorned with golden garlands, all of whom were gladly presented to the wielder of the Gandiva (Arjuna) by the chastiser of foes, Chitraratha, who vanquished and subdued in battle, with this wealth, O king, I shall (now) stake with you.

sa: अन्योन्यस्य प्रियाः सर्वे तथैव प्रियदर्शनाः। परैरभेद्याः संतुष्टाः को वो न स्पृहयेदिह॥
en: You are all attached to one another and you all feel delight at one another's presence; enemies cannot separate you from one another, and you are all contented.
